[paṭalaḥ 1] śrīḥ śubhamastu oṃ śrīsaccidānanda umāmaheśvarābhyāṃ namaḥ vīrāgamaḥ
samastavidyākusumairalaṃkṛtāṃ śaśiprabhāṃ bālaśaśāṅkaśekharām | ayugmanetrāmaravindajapriyāṃ namāmi devīṃ varadāṃ sarasvatīm || 1 ||
praṇamya bhagavantaṃ hi paripṛcchat pitāmaham | tantrāṇāmudbhavaṃ kiñcit tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho || 2 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śrṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | tanoti vipulānarthān tattvamantrasamāśritān || 3 ||
trāṇaṃ ca kurute puṃsāṃ tena mantramiti smṛtam | kāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvajitaṃ tathā || 4 ||
dīptaṃ sūryasahasraṃ ca aṃśumān suprabhedakam | vijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ syāyaṃbhuvamathānilam || 5 ||
vīraṃ ca rauravaṃ caiva makuṭaṃ vimalaṃ tathā | candrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathā || 6 ||
siddhaṃ santānaṃ sarvoktaṃ pārameśvarameva ca | kiraṇaṃ vātulaṃ caiva aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃhitā || 7 ||
kāmikādīni mantrāṇi teṣāṃ bhedaṃ ca tacchṛṇu | (***) caiva viprendra trividhaṃ bhedamucyate || 8 ||
yogajaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa pañcabhedena cocyate | cityaṃ ca ṣaḍvidhaṃ proktaṃ saptadhā kāraṇaṃ bhavet || 9 ||
ajitaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa caturṇāṃ bhedamucyate | dīptaṃ caiva tu viprendra navadhā bhedamucyate || 10 ||
sūkṣme ca ekamantraṃ syāt sāhasraṃ daśadhā bhavet | aṃśumān dvādaśaṃ bhedaṃ procyate kamalāsana || 11 ||
suprabhedaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ bhedamanyanna vidyate | śivabhedaṃ mayā proktaṃ upabhedaṃ śrṛṇuṣvathā || 12 ||
vijayaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa aṣṭadhā bhedamucyate | niśvāsaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa aṣṭadhā bhedamucyate || 13 ||
svayaṃbhuva viśeṣeṇa dvividhena pravakṣyate | āgneyamekarudraṃ tu bhedamanyanna vidyate || 14 ||
vīratantraṃ ca viprendra trayodaśabhedamucyate | rauravaṃ ṣaṭsu bhedena procyate kamalāsana || 15 ||
makuṭākhyamahātantraṃ dvividhena vidhīyate | vimalākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ caturdaśavidhaṃ bhavet || 16 ||
candrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca caturdaśavidhaṃ bhavet | mukhaṃ vipraṃ ca viprendra bhedapañcadaśa bhavet || 17 ||
protgītākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ bhedamucyate | lalitākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ tridhā bhedena cocyate || 18 ||
siddhatantraṃ ca viprendra caturvidhena cocyate | santānākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ saptabhedena cocyate || 19 ||
sarvoktaṃ tu mahātantraṃ pañcabhedena cocyate | pārameśvaratantraṃ tu saptabhedena vakṣyate || 20 ||
kṣaraṇākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ navadhā bhedamucyate | vimalākhyaṃ mahātantraṃ bhedaṃ dvādaśamucyate || 21 ||
tantrakāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava snehādviśeṣataḥ | dvihastau ca dvipādau ca ṛtvā vāta sthitaṃ bhavet || 22 ||
jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ bhedavanmukhamucyate | śuklavastraparīdhānaṃ yajñopavītasaṃyutam || 23 ||
mukhaṃ prati triṇetraṃ syāt sarvāṅgaṃ lakṣaṇairyutam | padmamadhye sthi(taṃ) daivaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 24 ||
tantrakāyaṃ mayā proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanam | pustakasya pramāṇaṃ ca śrṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 25 ||
caturdaśāṅgulaṃ vāpi pañcadaśyāṅgulaṃ tu vā | aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ vāpi navadaśāṅgulaṃ tu vā || 26 ||
athavā viṃśatirvāpi ekaviṃśatireva ca | dvāviṃśatirvā viprendra kārayet deśikottamaḥ || 27 ||
evaṃ pustakamākhyātaṃ mānāṅgulena kārayet | utsedhaṃ cāṣṭadhā hitvā ekāṃśaṃ caiva vistaram || 28 ||
vistāradvayataṃ proktaṃ pārśvau kampadvayau nyaset | tribhāgaṃ tu caturbhāgaṃ madhye suṣuramucyate || 29 ||
evaṃ pustakamānāṃ tu āyāmādikaṃ śṛṇu | labdhauccaṃ caiva viprendra mānāṅgulana bhājayet || 30 ||
ekāṅgulaṃ padaṃ proktaṃ hīnāṅgula vivarjayet | samaṃ cet tatparigrāhyamāyavyayamihocyate || 31 ||
vasubhirgaṇitaṃ tatra rāśibhiśca harettataḥ | śeṣamāyamidaṃ proktaṃ guṇenaiva vivardhayet || 32 ||
hareccaturdaśenaiva śeṣaṃ vyayamihocyate | padaṃ prati gaṇairvṛddhiraṣṭabhirgrāsayettataḥ || 33 ||
śeṣaṃ yoniriti khyātamaṣṭabhirvṛddhidaṃ padam | saptaviṃśatibhirgrāsaṃ labdhamiṣṭamiti smṛtam || 34 ||
śeṣaṃ nakṣatramevoktamaṣṭabhirvṛddhidaṃ padam | triṃśadbhirhāsayoktāni śeṣaṃ sthitirihocyate || 35 ||
aṣṭābhirvṛddhidaṃ caiva sa (**) hāsayettataḥ | śeṣaṃ vāramiti proktaṃ āyavyaya cayeti ca || 36 ||
āyuṣyaṃ caiva nakṣatraṃ tithivāramudāhṛtam | āyādhikaṃ vyayaṃ hīnaṃ saṃpatkaramihocyate || 37 ||
āyahīne vyayādhikye doṣākāramihocyate | tasmātsarvaprayatnena āyahīnanna kārayet || 38 ||
dhvajaṃ siṃhaṃ ca vṛṣabho hastiśceddhyayanāya ca | dhūmraśca gardabhaḥ kāko doṣāṇyetāni varjayet || 39 ||
yajamānasya ṛkṣeṇa nakṣatraṃ cānukūlakam | evaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā kartavyaṃ pustakaṃ param || 40 ||
ṛkchandodhidevānāṃ vakṣye tu kamalāsana | viśvāmitro'tha bālmīkiḥ kāśyapāṃścāṅgirastathā || 41 ||
gautamo gālavo gārgyo vasiṣṭhaścośanāstathā | caturdaśāṅgulādīni kramādvinyasya deśikaḥ || 42 ||
triṣṭup caiva anuṣṭup ca prakṛtirvikṛtistathā | gati catvāridaścaiva kati catvārireva ca || 43 ||
uttamaṃ tyaktamevaṃ tu chandasānāṃ vidhīyate | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśśiva eva ca || 44 ||
kālarudro nīlarudraḥ pralayāni sadāśiva | (***) śāṃgulādīni vedanāmiha cocyate || 45 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ lekhayedvāpi varṇenaiva tu lekhayet | ṣaṭpatirvātha pañcairvā lekhayet pustakaṃ tataḥ || 46 ||
ṛṣayo vasavaścaiva grahaditvaika (***) | paṅktirevaṃ samākhyātaṃ tattannāmnādhidaivataḥ || 47 ||
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ rājarāṣṭravivardhanam | ṛṣīṇaṃ bhujapatre tu lekhayettu dvijottamaḥ || 48 ||
svarṇe vā tāmrapatre tu lekhayeddeśikassadā | dvau pārśve kaḥ pa (***) pustakāyāma tatsamam || 49 ||
pratiṣṭhā vidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi lakṣaṇena samanvitam | śivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kuryādīśāne dakṣiṇe'pi vā || 50 ||
maṇṭapaṃ trividhaṃ madhye vediṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ | vedi bāhye tu paritaḥ parivārāni kārayet || 51 ||
vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā kuṇḍānyetāni kārayet | sthaṇḍilaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam || 52 ||
maṇṭape nairṛte bhāge śālīnā sthaṇḍilaṃ kuru | athāṅkurārpaṇaṃ kuryāt pañcāhe saptake'pi vā || 53 ||
vedikumbhaṃ ca taṃ madhye śivāstraṃ sāpi dhānakam | sahiraṇyaṃ sakūrcaṃ ca somarājādhidevatam || 54 ||
kṛtvā tava padaṃ tatra madhyame somakumbhakam | vinyasettu viśeṣeṇa pālikā aṣṭadikṣu vai || 55 ||
māṣamudgakulasthaṃ ca sarṣapaṃ caiva dāpayet | puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra pavamānena prokṣayet || 56 ||
suvarṇatantunā vipra kautukaṃ baddhayeddhṛdā | elālavaṅgatakkolamuśīraṃ candanairyutam || 57 ||
lepayet pustakaṃ tatra śayane śāyayettataḥ | śālinā vikaredveti padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet || 58 ||
śālyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ nyasya taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilā nyaset | pañcadhā śayanaṃ kalpya śāyayet pustakaṃ tathā || 59 ||
tattadāgamabījena śāyayecchayanopari | hrasva brahma samākhyātaṃ dīrghāṅgāni na cocyate || 60 ||
ādyakṣarasamāyuktaṃ anusvārasamanvitam | brahmamaṅgamiha proktaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca vidhīyate || 61 ||
vastreṇa veṣṭayettatra pustakaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | darpaṇaṃ caiva viprendra evameva krameṇa tu || 62 ||
sarasvatīṃ nyasettatra pustakasya tu madhyame | pustakasyendra digbhāge vinyasetkumbhameva ca || 63 ||
śuddhodakena saṃpūrya sakūrca syā vidhānakam | sarvatra sahiraṇyaṃ ca sarasvatīṃ nyasettataḥ || 64 ||
mūlamantreṇa vinyasya arcayettu viśeṣataḥ | pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasedvardhanīṣu ca || 65 ||
savastraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sakūrcādīni vinyaset | vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca balavīṃ balapramathanīṃ (?) sarvabhūtamanonmanīm || 66 ||
pūrvādīni ca vinyasya pustake ca manonmanīm | hṛdayādi ṣaḍaṅgaiśca pūjayettu vidhānataḥ || 67 ||
havirnivedayettatra paścāddhomaṃ samācaret | pālāśaṃ pūrvato bhāge aśvatthaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā || 68 ||
paścime (***) vaṃ tu apāmārgaṃ tathottare | audumbaraṃ tathaiśānyaṃ pālāśairvāpi homayet || 69 ||
samidājya carūn lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān | samidhā sadyamantreṇa īśānenājya homayet || 70 ||
caruṃ vai hṛdayenaiva lājaṃ vai śirasā hunet | sarṣapaṃ sadyamantreṇa netreṇa tu yavāṃstathā || 71 ||
kavacena tilān hutvā saptadravyamihocyate | sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vāpi hūyate || 72 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi pañcāśat pañcaviṃśatiḥ | dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā pustakaṃ sparśayeddhṛdā || 73 ||
sarvadravyasamāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaran | sviṣṭamagneti mantreṇa juhuyāttadanantaram || 74 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale pūrvabhūti viśeṣataḥ | tattāgamaṃ ca bījena prokṣayedvardhanīṃ tataḥ || 75 ||
sannidhau darpaṇaṃ tasya abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayet | havirnivedayet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ || 76 ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayetpaścādvastrahemādireva ca | brāhmaṇān bhojayettatra saptakanyāṃśca pūjayet || 77 ||
bauddhamārhataṃ caiva śaivaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā | kapālaṃ pāñcarātraṃ ca ṣaḍaite samayā smṛtāḥ || 78 ||
eteṣāṃ saṃkaraṃ caiva tatra saṃkaramucyate | mantrasaṃkaradoṣeṇa rājā rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati || 79 ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena saṃkarannaiva kārayet | aṣṭāviṃśati bhedena śaivabhedaṃ vidhīyate || 80 ||
eteṣāṃ saṃkaraṃ caiva na doṣāya prakalpyate | dīkṣitasya sudhīrasya śivabhaktiparasya ca || 81 ||
tasmai devaṃ tato grāhyaṃ traivarṇikamihocyate | adīkṣitaṃ tat srota syānna deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 82 ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śivalokaṃ mahīyate | tantrāvatāramevoktaṃ pañcākṣaravidhiṃ śṛṇu || 83 ||
[iti vīratantre ṣaṭsahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ tantrāvatārapaṭalo(laḥ) prathamaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 2 pañcākṣarapaṭalaḥ]
pitāmahauvāca(ha uvāca)(-)
namastutvā jagannāthaṃ parīpṛcchat pitāmahaḥ | śrīpañcākṣarakalpaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ vada me prabho || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva caturānana | namaskāreṇa saṃyuktaṃ śiva ityakṣaradvayam || 2 ||
ādivargaṃ catuthyantaṃ yavargaṃ ca dvitīyakam | tadvargāntaṃ saptamaṃ syāt pañcākṣaramiti smṛtam || 3 ||
etanmantramanusmṛtya bindunādasamāyutam | caturthyā tu samāyuktaṃ pañcākṣaramiti smṛtam ||
nakāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca śikāraṃ ca vakārakaḥ | yakāreṇa samāyuktaṃ pañcākṣaramihocyate || 4 ||
praṇavena samāyuktaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramiti dvayam | ṛgvedājjāyate vipra nakārākṣaramucyate || 5 ||
makāraṃ tu yajurvedaṃ śikāraṃ sāmavedakam | atharveda tu vakāraṃ yakāramitihāsake || 6 ||
nakāraṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu īśvareṇa samāyutam | sāvitrīchandasā yuktaṃ gatamena samāyutam || 7 ||
sthānaṃ sadyamukhaṃ caiva nakārākṣaramucyate | makāraṃ pītavarṇaṃ tu brahmāṇa trādhidaivatam || 8 ||
śikāraṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ tu viṣṇustatrādhidaivatam | triṣṭupchandassamāyuktaṃ viśvāmitrasamanvitam || 9 ||
sthānaṃ aghoravaktraṃ syāt śikārākṣaramucyate | vakāraṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu skandastatrādhidaivatam || 10 ||
bṛhaspatisamāyuktaṃ viśvāmitrasamanvitam | sthānaṃ aghoravaktraṃ syāt śikārākṣaramucyate || 11 ||
bṛhaspatisamāyuktaṃ āṅgīrasasamanvitam | puruṣasya mukhaṃ sthānaṃ vakārākṣara kīrtitam || 12 ||
yakāraṃ śuklavarṇaṃ tu vighneśastatra daivatam | sāvitrīchandasāyuktaṃ bhāradvājena saṃyutam || 13 ||
īśānasya mukhaṃ sthānaṃ yakārākṣaramucyate | pañcākṣaramiha proktaṃ śṛṇu tatvākṣaratvataḥ || 14 ||
akāraśca ukāraśca makāraśca tridhā bhavet | akāraṃ brahmadaivatyaṃ ukāraṃ viṣṇudaivatam || 15 ||
makāraṃ maheśvarastatra adhidevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | ṛgvedaṃ tu akārassyāt yujurvedaṃ makārakam || 16 ||
makāraṃ sāmavedaṃ tu idamanyat śṛṇuṣva tu | akāraṃ sātvikaṃ vidyādukāraṃ rājasaṃ bhavet || 17 ||
makāraṃ tāmasaṃ jñeyaṃ makāraṃ śāntikaṃ bhavet | ikāraṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vidyāt akāraṃ mābhicārakam || 18 ||
akāraṃ śvetavarṇaṃ syādukāraṃ raktameva ca | makāraṃ pītavarṇaṃ syāt devamevaṃ krameṇa tu || 19 ||
guṇena saṃdhikāryaṃ syādoṃkāraṃ śivamucyate | oṃkāreṇa samāyuktaṃ ṣaḍakṣaramihocyate || 20 ||
rudrākṣeṇa japaṃ kuryāt pañcākṣarasamāyutam | aṅgulyāṃ tu japedekaṃ pañcāyāmramayaṃ bhavet || 21 ||
rekhe aṣṭaguṇaṃ proktaṃ dīpairdaśaguṇaṃ bhavet | śataśayaistu vijñeyaṃ pravālaṃ tu sahasrakam || 22 ||
sphaṭikaṃ daśasāhasraṃ mauktikairlakṣameva ca | padmākṣaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sauvarṇaṃ daśakoṭikam || 23 ||
kuśagranthyā koṭiśataṃ rudrākṣeṇa tvanāyakam | nyāsaṃ kuryāttato mantrī pañcākṣaramihocyate || 24 ||
aṅguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsamudāhṛtam | kaniṣṭhādyaṅgulānāṃ tu saṃhāranyāsamucyate || 25 ||
yakāraṃ karatale vipra nyāsaṃ kuryāttato budhaḥ | karanyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā aṅganyāsamatha śṛṇu || 26 ||
yakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya vakāraṃ tu lalāṭake | śakāraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe tu makāraṃ hṛdaye nyaset || 27 ||
nakāraṃ nābhideśe tu vinyasettu viśeṣataḥ | sarvāṅgeṣu ca viprendra oṃkāraṃ vinyasettataḥ || 28 ||
sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā aṣṭottara śataṃ tu vā | pañcāśat pañcaviṃśairvā japaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥ || 29 ||
prāsādena tu mantreṇa hṛdayena samanvitam | japaṃ kuryāttu viprendra praṇavena samāyutam || 30 ||
gṛheṣu phalamekaṃ syāt goṣṭhe daśaguṇaṃ bhavet | nadītīre śataṃ vidyāt sahasraṃ devatālaye || 31 ||
japtvā viṃśatibhirlakṣaissvāyambhuvamavāpnuyāt | lakṣalakṣaṃ tatā japtvā raudraṃ padamavāpnuyāt || 32 ||
praveśe śivamīśānaṃ tyaktvā saṃsārasāgarāt | śrīpañcākṣaramevoktaṃ mantroddhāraṇa śṛṇuṣvatha || 33 ||
[iti vīratantre śrīpañcākṣarapaṭalo dvitīyaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 3 mantroddhārapaṭalaḥ]
ajñānāṃ tava magnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmatha | sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ mantroddhāraṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana (!)| mananaṃ sarvavaktrāṇāṃ trāṇaṃ saṃsārasāgarāt || 2 ||
mananatrāṇadharmitvaṃ mantramityabhidhīyate | mahendre malaye caiva sahye vindhye tathaiva ca || 3 ||
kedāre nirmade caiva gṛhe vāpi viśeṣataḥ | gaṅgākūle samudre vā prāsāde vā viśeṣataḥ || 4 ||
gavāṃ goṣṭhe viśeṣeṇa nadyāṃ vāpi taṭākake | anyeṣu śuddhadeśeṣu mantramuddhārayetkramāt || 5 ||
ācāryaśca śucirbhūtvā kṛtopavāsasaṃyutaḥ | pūrvarātrādhivāsaṃ ca prabhāte mantramuddharet || 6 ||
raktena dhātunā vipra akṣaraṃ lekhayeddhṛdā | śivatattve pare sūkṣme bindurutpadyate tathā || 7 ||
bindornādassamutpanno nādācchaktirajāyata | śaktestu vāk bhavannādaṃ vāk bhavāt ṣoḍaśā kalāt || 8 ||
kaladhātvañjanaṃ jātaṃ vyañjanāt sarvatantrakam | śāntaṃ sarvagataṃ śūnyaṃ śivarūpamiti bruvan || 9||
avargaṃ ca kavargaṃ ca cavargaṃ ca ṭavargakam | tavargaṃ ca pavargaṃ ca yavargaṃ ca śavargakam || 10 ||
ādivargeṣu ṛ ṛ ca caturakṣara varjayet | varjayeccaiva viprendra avargaṃ ca daśākṣaram || 11 ||
pūrvaṃ hrasvaṃ samākhyātamaparaṃ dīrghamucyate | hrasva brahma samākhyātaṃ dīrghāṅgāni ca cocyate || 12 ||
sadyojātaṃ tu gokṣīra sadṛśaṃ varṇamucyate | japāpuṣpanibhaṃ vāmamaghoramañjanaprabham || 13 ||
puruṣaṃ kuṅkumaprakhyamīśāna sphaṭikaṃ bhavet | brahmavarṇa samākhyātaṃ tadrūpaṃ vakṣate'dhunā || 14 ||
dvinetrāṃ cāruvadanāṃ sustanāṃ ca suyauvanām | dvipādāṃ ca dvihastāṃ ca pañcabrahmamihocyate || 15 ||
ṣaḍaṅgāni pravakṣyāmi hṛdayaṃ ca śirastathā | śikhā kavaca netraṃ ca astramantreṇa saṃyutam || 16 ||
indudhūmaṃ tathā caiva kiṃciddhūmraṃ tathaiva ca | ravinibha yugāntāni saṃprāpyaṃ tu pitāmahā || 17 ||
ṣaḍaṅgānyaiva sarveṣāṃ mantravarṇaṃ vicintayet | dvinetrāṃ ca dvihastāṃ ca dvipādena samanvitām || 18 ||
jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktāmupavītasamāyutām | śuklavastrasamāyuktāṃ ṣaḍaṅgānāmihocyate || 19||
strīrūpaṃ bhāvayet brahma ṣaḍaṅgān puruṣo bhavet | japākusumasaṃkāśaṃ kundapuṣpanibhaṃ bhavet || 20 ||

śivaviṣṇusamārūḍhamaṣṭamasyā susaṃyutam | prathamasya dvitīyaṃ tu bindunādasamanvitam || 25 ||
vipreśvarāṇāṃ bījāni kramaśo vakṣyate'dhunā | gaṇāmbikā ca caṇḍeśo nandīśaśca tathaiva ca || 26 ||
mahākālaśca vṛṣabho vighneśaśca tathaiva ca | bhṛṅgīśaśca mahāsena svanāmādyakṣarairyutam || 27 ||
indraścāgniryamaścaiva nirṛtirvaruṇa eva ca | vāyussomastathaiśānaḥ bahmā viṣṇuśca saṃyutam || 28 ||
svānāmādyena bījena bindunādasamanvitam | vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṅkuśam || 29 ||
gadā triśūlī cakraṃ ca padmaṃ caiva daśāyudham | svanāmādyena bījena bindunādasamanvitam || 30 ||
darpaṇaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ yugacāmare | śrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṅkhaṃ dīpo devāṣṭamaṅgalam || 31 ||
svanāmādyena bījena bindunādasamanvitam | ṣaṣṭhavargāt dvitīyaṃ tu caturthyādyena saṃyutam || 32 ||
dvitīye pañcamaṃ caiva ādyakṣarasamāyutam | visargeṇa samāyuktaṃ pāśupadāstramucyate || 33 ||
oṃ chi ci ri kṣī kūrcaiva kṣurikāstramihocyate | bhūtānāṃ piśācānāṃ gandharvā yakṣakinnarāḥ || 34 ||
mantrāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ anyeṣāṃ gaṇameva ca | svanāmadyakṣaraṃ vipra bindunādasamanvitam || 35 ||
bindunādasamāyuktamācāryaṃ bījamucyate | mūrttipānāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāmevameva krameṇa tu || 36 ||

īśvareṇa samāyuktaṃ vyomavyāpimihocyate | vasiṣṭhena samāyuktaṃ prakṛticchandasaṃyutam || 55 ||
śivarūpeṇa saṃyuktaṃ śivamantramihocyate | ācāryasya ca bījaṃ ca ṛṣichando'dhidevatāḥ || 56 ||

dvitīyasyādisaṃyuktaṃ dvitīyasvarabhāṣitam || bindunādasamāyuktaṃ kāmikākṣaramucyate || 60 ||
kāmikākṣaramevoktaṃ yogajaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha | saptamena ca saṃyuktaṃ ekādaśa samanvitam || 61 ||

saptamasya tṛtīyaṃ tu bindunādasamanvitam | kāraṇākhyamidaṃ proktaṃ prathamasyādisaṃyutam || 64 ||
ākārabījasaṃyuktaṃ saptamasya dvitīyakam | bindunādasamāyuktamajitaṃ tviha cocyate || 65 ||
pañcamasya tṛtīyaṃ tu saptamasyādisaṃyutam | dvādaśākṣarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 66 ||
dīptabījamidaṃ proktamaṣṭavargaṃ tṛtīyakam | dvādaśākṣarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 67 ||
sūkṣmabījamidaṃ proktamaṣṭamasya tṛtīyakam | saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu māyābījena saṃyutam || 68 ||
bindunādasamāyuktaṃ sahasraṃ cocyate mayā | antyākṣarasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 69 ||
suprabhedākṣaraṃ proktaṃ saptavargasya cāntikam | tṛtīyasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 70 ||
vijayaṃ caiva viprendra pañcamasyāntasaṃyutam | māyālepasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 71 ||
niśvāsatantramevoktaṃ aṣṭavargatṛtīyakam | saptamasya caturthaṃ tu māyābījasamanvitam || 72 ||
bindunādasamāyuktaṃ syāyaṃbhuvamiti smṛtam | antyākṣaramiti proktaṃ dvitīyasvarabhūṣitam || 73 ||
bindunādasamāyuktamāgneyamiha cocyate | saptamasyādimaṃ bījaṃ māyānalasamanvitam || 74 ||
bindunādasamāyuktaṃ vīratantramihocyate | saptamasya dvitīyaṃ tu dvādaśasvarabhūṣitam || 75 ||
ākāśabījasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam | akṣarāṇāṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rauravaṃ procyate mayā || 76 ||
ṣaṣṭhamasyāntimaṃ bījaṃ antyākṣarasamāyutam | māyānalasamāyuktaṃ makuṭākṣaramucyate || 77 ||
saptamasyādimaṃ bījaṃ māyānalasamanvitam | bindunādasamāyuktaṃ vimalaṃ caiva kathyate || 78 ||
tṛtīyasyādimaṃ bījaṃ māyānalasamanvitam | bindunādasamāyuktaṃ candrajñānamihocyate || 79 ||
aṣṭavargāttṛtīyaṃ tu dvādaśasvarabhūṣitam | bindunādasamāyuktaṃ bimbasyākṣaramucyate || 80 ||
ṣaṣṭhamasyādimaṃ caiva dvādaśe cānalo bhavet | bindunādasamāyuktaṃ protgītamiha cocyate || 81 ||
saptamasya tṛtīyaṃ tu ekādaśena saṃyutam | bindunādasamāyuktaṃ lalitasvara bhūṣitam || 82 ||
aṣṭavargatṛtīyaṃ tu saptamasvarasaṃyutam | analena samāyuktaṃ siddhāṃ tantramihocyate || 83 ||
aṣṭavargatṛtīyaṃ tu aṣṭasvara vibhūṣitam | saptamasya dvitīyena bindunāda samanvitam || 84 ||
santānasya tu mantro'yamaṣṭavargādimaṃ yutam | dvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 85 ||
śarvot gītamidaṃ proktaṃ pṛṣṭhavargādisaṃyutam | māyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 86 ||
pārameśvaramevoktaṃ dvitīyasyādimaṃ yutam | dvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 87 ||
kiraṇasyākṣaraṃ proktaṃ saptamaṃ ca caturthakam | māyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitam || 88 ||
vātulasya tu mantro'yamaṣṭāviṃśatibhedakam | chandadaivatānvakṣye āgamānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 89 ||
vasiṣṭhena samāyuktaṃ catvāri chandasaṃyutam | tava rūpeṇa saṃyuktaṃ kāmikādīni sapta ca || 90 ||
sahasrādīni saptaite vyāsenaiva samāyutam | ajitaśchandasaṃyuktaṃ viṣṇustatrādhidaivatam || 91 ||
evameva krameṇaiva mantrāṇāṃ procyate mayā | adīkṣitairna śrotavyaṃ na deyaṃ na prakāśitam || 92 ||
śiṣyāṇāṃ caiva dātavyaṃ samāsāt kathayāmi te | aṣṭavargāttṛtīyāntaṃ ādyakṣarasamāyutam || 93 ||
aṣṭavarga tṛtīyaṃ tu ādyakṣaravivarjitam | śaktibījamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhanam || 94 ||
sadāśivasya rūpaṃ tu vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvataḥ | śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ tryakṣaṃ daśabhujairyutam || 95 ||
pañcavaktrayutaṃ deva jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitam | divyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 96 ||
paraśuṃ khaḍga vajraṃ ca abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe kare | pāśaṃ cāṅkuśa ghaṇṭā ca nāgaṃ vahniṃśca vāmake || 97 ||
padmāsanāsino devaṃ netraiḥ pañcadaśairyutam | etatsakalamākhyātaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam || 98 ||

puṣpāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ patrāṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca | viśeṣaṃ śrotumicchāmi taṃ me brūhi maheśvara || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
yāvatpuṣpasya saṃkhyāni pūjānāṃ yogyameva ca | ayogyaṃ hi ca puṣpāṇāṃ tāvacchṛṇu tapodhana || 2 ||
arkapuṣpasahasrācca karavīraṃ viśiṣyate | karavīra sahasrebhyaḥ bilvapatra viśiṣyate || 3 ||
bilvapatrasahasrebhyaḥ padmapatraṃ viśiṣyate | padmapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ puṇḍarīkaṃ viśiṣyate || 4 ||
puṇḍarīkasahasrebhyaḥ śatapatraṃ viśiṣyate | śatapatrasahasreṇa (*) srakarṇaṃ viśiṣyate || 5 ||
sahasrakarṇaṃ viśiṣṭebhyaḥ bakapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate | bakapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ dhūddhūrakaṃ viśiṣyate || 6 ||
dhūddhūrakaṃ sahasrebhyaḥ droṇapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate | droṇapuṣpa sahasrebhyaḥ apamārgaṃ viśiṣyate || 7 ||
apāmārga sahasrebhyaḥ kuśapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate | kuśapuṣpa sahasrebhyaḥ śamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 8 ||
śamīpuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ vyāghātaṃ tu viśiṣyate | vyāghātānāṃ sahasrebhyo śaṅkhapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 9 ||
śaṅkhapuṣpa sahasrebhyaḥ vyāghrapuṣpaṃ praśasyate | vyāghrapuṣpa sahasrebhyo sadābhadraṃ viśiṣyate || 10 ||
śvetārkasya ca viprendra bṛhaddroṇaṃ viśiṣyate | bṛhaddroṇaviśiṣṭebhyaḥ nīlotpalaṃ viśiṣyate || 11 ||
(?) suvarṇa dhūddhūrapuṣpa nīlotpala samudbhavet | prakṣālya pañcagavyena nīlotpalaṃ tu kāñcanam || 12 ||
punaḥ pūjāṃ prakartavyāṃ sarvalokahitāya ca | japāpuṣpakadambaṃ ca punnāgaṃ ca tathaiva ca || 13 ||
droṇapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ viṣṇukrānti japastathā | aṃjayaṃ mallikā jājī jātī javantireva ca || 14 ||
dhūddhūrakasamaṃ jñeyaṃ campakaṃ kaṭakaṃ tathā | bilvapatrasamaṃ jñeyaṃ punnāgaṃ ca viśiṣyate || 15 ||
kobjaṃ mālatī caiva karavīraṃ samutbhevet | padmapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ vakulaṃ parameva ca || 16 ||
aśokaṃ śokamandāraṃ vyāghātaṃ samamucyate | śvetaṃ kusumaṃ raktotpalamapāmārga samaṃ bhavet || 17 ||
paṭṭikā raktakaṃkhyā ca vyāghrapuṣpasamaṃ bhavet | gandhapuṣpaṃ gaṇḍapuṣpaṃ padmapuṣpasamaṃ bhavet || 18 ||
indravallī ca tulasī arkapuṣpasamaṃ bhavet | koraṇḍakasya puṣpaṃ ca apāmārgasamaṃ bhavet || 19 ||
bakapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ ambikā atha śiṃśukā | sūryavarttā nāga (*****) ñca śaṅkhameva ca || 20 ||
dhūrddhūrakasamaṃ jñeyaṃ mahābhadranṛṇāvapi | vajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca marakataṃ mauktikāni ca || 21 ||
indranīlaṃ mahānīlaṃ vaiḍūryaṃ ca pravālakam | nīlotpalasamaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvaratnāni caiva hi || 22 ||
saṃke pari pālāśaṃ ca kadambapuṣpameva ca | aṃkolaṃ sakaraṃ caiva priyaṅgu jambu caiva ca || 23 ||
arkapuṣpasamaṃ jñeyaṃ pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ | palāśapuṣpaṃ viprendra raviraśmisamāyutam || 24 ||
navasāṇḍe parigrāhya ṣāṇmāsaṃ pūjayecchivam | yavagodhūmanīvāra vrīhi vaiṇavakāni ca || 25 ||
niṣpāva mānaśyāmaṃ ca nīlamudgaka eva ca | aṅkurāṇi prakartavyaṃ pūjayecchivamādarāt || 26 ||

giriberi ca patrī ca karavīrasamaṃ bhavet | giriyārkau girikarṇī ca dhūrddhūraka samaṃ bhavet || 29 ||
nirgandhātyagragandhāni kusumāni vivarjayet | puṣpāṇāmapyalabhettu phalānāṃ pūjayettataḥ || 30 ||
phalānāmapyalābhettu mūlenaiva tu pūjayet | mūlānāmapyalābhe tu bhaktyā caiva tu pūjayet || 31 ||
evamevakrameṇaiva pūjayedevakaṃkaṇī | ketakī mādhavī kundamadhudīmradayaṃtikā || 32 ||

sa rājyaṃ labhate'vaśyaṃ svapnāntaṃ dṛśyate naraḥ | candrasya maṇḍalaṃ dṛśye bhakṣaṇe vā viśeṣataḥ || 147 ||
bhakṣaṇādrājyamāpnoti darśanādardhamāpnuyāt | suraṃ vāpyasuraṃ vāpi pānaṃ vā dṛśyate yadi || 148 ||
vidyālābhaṃ dvijānāṃ tu itarastu dhanaṃ labhet | tarate sṛkniśī vāpi mahadarthamavāpnuyāt || 149 ||
amedhyadarśanaṃ vakṣye arthalābhaṃ vinaśyati | kṣīrapāne mahāvyādhirghṛtapāne mahadbhayam || 150 ||
raktapānena syādvyādhī rājyaṃ ca dadhibhojanam | pāyasaṃ caiva vaiśvānaraṃ vā vāda līyate tataḥ || 151 ||
mahatsukhamavāpnoti māsānmaraṇamāpnuyāt | śyenaṃ vā kapiṃ vāpi dhūrttaṃ caiva samūlakam || 152 ||
mūrdhni vā līyate bhakṣe māsānmaraṇamāpnuyāt | svadante patite caiva bandhurmaraṇamāpnuyāt || 153 ||
(?) mataṃ malinavastraṃ saṃyutaṃ (**********) | te tu mahāvyādhi raktaṃ vā bhāmavāpnuyāt || 154 ||
nigale cātra dṛṣṭe tu mahāvyādhimavāpnuyāt | raktavastraiśca mālyairvā kṛṣṇaṃ vāpi ca dhāryate || 155 ||
pādadeśe sthitā nārī vyādhito maraṇaṃ bhavet | kathayukta rathāru (***) te tu yamālayam || 156 ||
māsānmaraṇamāpnoti svapnānte dṛśyate yadi | rūpe tu patite dṛśye maraṇaṃ tasya nirdiśet || 157 ||
sanyāsaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ bodhyaḥ dṛśyate maraṇaṃ bhavet | śai (. . . . .) cānyadvayaṃ vāpi raktasa(va)strāṃ sumaṅgalīm || 158 ||
(***) maghā strīyamavāpnoti dṛśyate yadi | tālavṛkṣaphalaṃ caiva phalānāṃ varjayettataḥ || 159 ||
kiṃśukaṃ raktapuṣpāṇi karavīraṃ tu varjayet | dhūrddhūrakaṃ vinā vipra śvetapuṣpaṃ pradṛśyate || 160 ||
narāṇāṃ brāhmaṇaśśreṣṭha rājñāṃ tu madhyamaṃ bhavet | śukahastaṃ ca viprendra pakṣīṇāṃ tu pradarśayet || 161 ||
dhenuṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ caiva siṃhaṃ caiva mṛgaṃ tathā | svapne pradṛśyate vipra āyuṣyaṃ caiva vardhanam || 162 ||
marīcaṃ sarṣapaṃ mudgaṃ dṛśyate vyādhimāpnuyāt | kadalī nālikeraṃ vā panasaṃ mātulaṅgakam || 163 ||
eteṣāṃ tu phalaṃ dṛśye dhanadhānyamavāpnuyāt | devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ vā devapatnī ca vā sthirā || 164 ||
yastu paśyati svapnānte dhanamāyuryaśo bhavet | āyaṃ cāhanaṃ vāpi dṛśyāt kuḍumbavardhanam || 165 ||
māsaṃ vāpi ca matsyaṃ vā labdho śubhapradaṃ bhavet | ṛkṣāṃ vā taskaraṃ vāpi mahiṣaṃ vyāghrameva ca || 166 ||
rājā pīḍāmavāpnoti prātarevādhimādiśet | snānakāryaṃ prakuryāttu sadyo vyādhirvimucyate || 167 ||
raṇḍāṃ ca muṇḍanaṃ vāpi nagnāṃ strīṃ vāpi paśyati | dhānyakṣayaṃ bhavettasya svapnānte'pi na saṃśayaḥ || 168 ||
puruṣaṃ vāpi mūtraṃ vā svapne saṃdarśayettataḥ | vāstu naśyati svāpānte arthahānimavāpnuyāt || 169 ||
śālyannaṃ bhuñjate yastu āyuśśrīkīrtivardhanam | strībhissumaṅgalībhistu saṃyogaṃ maithunaṃ śubham || 170 ||
śubhe tu pravite dīkṣāmaśubhe homamācaret | sahasra paramāṃ devī śatamūlā śatāṅkurā || 171 ||
sarvaṃ haratu me pāpaṃ dūrvā duḥsvapnanāśinī | idaṃ mantraṃ japitvā tu dūrvāṃ śirasi nikṣipet || 172 ||
svapnaṃ tu prathame yāme vatsaratrayasākinaḥ | dvitīyena dvayaṃ caiva dviyāme caikavatsaram || 173 ||
caturthe'pi ca yāme ca ṣaṇmāsātsidhyate tataḥ | uṣāyāṃ tu daśāhe tu prāhe pañcadaśaṃ dinam || 174 ||
aruṇodaya velāyāṃ saptāhāt siddhimāpnuyāt | evameva krameṇaiva svapnaṃ caiva parīkṣayet || 175 ||
evaṃ parīkṣya bahudhā prabhāte snapanaṃ bhavet | dīkṣāyā maṇḍalaṃ proktaṃ dīkṣāvidhimatha śṛṇu || 176 ||

pitāmaha uvāca(-)
dīkṣāmārgaṃ kathaṃ devaṃ mantranyāsa kathaṃ prabho | śaivāssaptavidhā ke vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
pitāmaha mahāprājña yat tvayā paricoditam | tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 2 ||
śrīyate satvasadbhāvaṃ śrīyate pāśapañcaram | tayostu saṃpuṭīkṛtya sā dīkṣā iti kathyate || 3 ||
saptadhā śaivamuddiṣṭaṃ matāni gadataśśrṛṇu | anādi śaivaṃ prathamaṃ ādiśaiva dvitīyakam || 4 ||
mahāśaivaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu caturthaṃ cānuśaivakam | avāntaraṃ tu śaivaṃ tu pañcamaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ || 5 ||
ṣaṣṭha pravara śaivaṃ tu saptamaṃ cāntya śaivakam | śaivāssapta tayā proktāsteṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvathā || 6 ||
anādi śaiva vijñeyaṃ ahameva na saṃśayaḥ | śivadvijāśca viprendrā ādiśaivāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 7 ||
kauśikaḥ kāśyapaścaiva bhāradvājo'trireva ca | gautamaścāpyagastyaśca pañcavaktreṣu dīkṣitāḥ || 8 ||
eteṣāṃ tu ṛṣīṇāṃ tu jātā ye ca śivadvijaḥ | punardīkṣāṃ na kurvanti kartavyā cettu niṣphalam || 9 ||
upanayīta kāle tu maṇḍale pūjayecchivam | snapanaṃ cāṅga śuddhyarthaṃ kārayettu śivadvijān || 10 ||
mahāśaivaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ (**) ñcaiva samanvitam | adīkṣitaścaturvedī śivapūjāṃ na kārayet || 11 ||
śrutyarthaṃ parameśānaṃ dīkṣāparahito dvijaḥ | ṣāṇmāsātpatanaṃ yāti yajeddevalaka smṛtāḥ || 12 ||
trīṇi varṣāṇi bhṛtyarthamanyaliṅge'pi dīkṣitāḥ | pūjayedvṛti vipraistu sa vai devalako bhavet || 13 ||
eteṣāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ malakānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | sthitaliṅge tu yatpūjā na kurvīta kadācana || 14 ||
kṣatriyaścaiva vaiśyaśca anuśaivamihocyate | śūdro'pyantara śaivastu ucyate kramaśo'dhunā || 15 ||
savarṇāmbaṣṭhamadhye stho kulālo pāraśivastathā | pravara śaivamiti khyātamidamanya śṛṇuṣvathā || 16 ||
anyeṣāṃ caiva jātīnāmanyaśaivamihocyate | (?) ādiśaiva na kartavya pratiṣṭhā arcanāntakam || 17 ||
anyathā kārayedvastu niṣphalaṃ caivamāpnuyāt | śaivabhedaṃ mayā khyātaṃ dīkṣāvidhimatha śṛṇu || 18 ||
rohiṇī śravaṇārdrā ca śraviṣṭhā trīṇi cottarā | puṣyaśśatabhiṣak caiva dīkṣānakṣatramucyate || 19 ||
vṛṣabhaṃ vātha siṃhaṃ vā vṛścikaṃ kumbhameva ca | mithunaṃ vāpi kanyā vā dhanurvā mīnameva ca || 20 ||
ete ca rāśayaḥ proktāścararāśiśca varjayet | dvitīyā pañcamī vāpi ṣaṣṭhā vāpi viśeṣataḥ || 21 ||
dvādaśīṃ vātha kartavyaṃ trayodaśyāmathāpi vā | eteṣāṃ tithayaḥ proktā vārāṃścaiva śṛṇuṣvatha || 22 ||
somaśśukrabudho vāpi jīvavāramathāpi vā | bṛhaspatyudayaṃ vāpi śukrodayamathāpi vā || 23 ||
śukrodaye tu kurvīte somodayamathāpi vā | (?) ṣaṣṭhasvaragṛhāṇāttu paścāt śiṣyāṃstu preṣitān || 24 ||
sa śuddhahṛdayān bhaktān kṛtaśauco jitendriyaḥ | pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuryādācamya ca vidhānataḥ || 25 ||
netre bandhaṃ prakartavyaṃ hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ | dukūlapaṭṭasaṃyuktaṃ kārpāsikamathāpi vā || 26 ||
uttamaṃ dvādaśaṃ hastaṃ madhyamaṃ daśahastakam | adhamaṃ navahastaṃ tu catustālaṃ tu vismṛtam || 27 ||
jīrṇena sphaṭikenaiva daṇḍe tu maraṇaṃ bhavet | sa daśāhatavastreṇa netre baddhaṃ tu kārayet || 28 ||
vastradvayena saṃyuktaṃ netramantradaśaṃ japet | vyomavyāpiṃ japettatra tatpuruṣeṇa samāyutam || 29 ||
netrabaddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ svarṇapuṣpasamāyutam | uttamaṃ daśaniṣkaṃ tu aṣṭaniṣkaṃ tu madhyamam || 30 ||
adhamaṃ pañcaniṣkaṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ cocyate mayā | daridrāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yathālābhena kārayet || 31 ||
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā ekacittena buddhimān | īśānena tu mantreṇa puṣpahaste nidhāpayet || 32 ||
pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā vāmadevena mantrataḥ | dhyātvā tu parameśānaṃ śivamantreṇa buddhimān || 33 ||
maṇḍale vikiretpuṣpaṃ svastimaṅgalavācakaiḥ | yasminmantre padet puṣpaṃ nāmagotraṃ tu tanmatam || 34 ||
samantraṃ sadyate tasya kurute (**) vyāpya tu | īśānasya dale dvyādhirāgneyyāṃ śodhanaṃ tathā || 35 ||
nairṛtyāṃ śrīkaraṃ proktaṃ manāyuṣyaṃ tu vāyudik | caturdikṣu ca viprendra tantrikāramiti smṛtam || 36 ||
karṇike patite puṣpe sukhaṃ caiva bhavettadā | īśānasya dale caiva netrannāma mihocyate || 37 ||
udakena samāyuktaṃ bhasmaṃ śirasi nikṣipet | gandhādibhiryamabhyarcya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ || 38 ||
śivāgre caikakumbhaṃ tu śālyopari ca vinyaset | sasūtrān sāpidhānāṃśca savastrān hemasaṃyutān || 39 ||
śivamantramanusmṛtya sthāpayet kumbhameva ca | tasyodakena viprendra prokṣayet śiṣyamūrdhani || 40 ||
īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyaset | aghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayet || 41 ||
sadyojātaṃ nyasetpāde vinyaset śiṣyadarśake | hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyaset || 42 ||
śikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥ | astraṃ hastapradeśe tu netraṃ netreṣu vinyaset || 43 ||
devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge kamaṭhākāramākramam | kūrcenaiva samāyuktamāsanaṃ tatprakīrtitam || 44 ||
āsanasya tu śiṣyaśca pūrvābhimukhameva ca | agnibījena viprendra trikoṇamaṇḍale sthite || 45 ||
pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ samārabhya dehe dadyāt śiro'ntakam | amṛtena plāvayettatra ekacittena vai budhāḥ || 46 ||
candramaṇḍalasaṃkāśamakāraṃ janmasaṃbhavam | vidyātattvamukāraṃ tu śivatattvaṃ makārakam || 47 ||
omityanena kamalaṃ yogapīṭhamadhomukham | cintayedamṛtaṃ toyaṃ suṣumnābhinnaṃmastakam || 48 ||
tena plāvitamātmānamāpūryaṃ taṃ vicintayet | imāṃ yo'bhyasate nityaṃ samādhiṃ mṛtyunāśakam || 49 ||
na tasya jāyate mṛtyuriti śāstrasya niścayaḥ | ṣaḍadhva vinyasetpaścāt śiṣyadehe viśeṣataḥ || 50 ||
mantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca tattvādhvā bhuvanātmakam | varṇādhvā ca kalādhvā ca viṃśatyekapadaṃ śivam || 51 ||
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva ātmā dindriyameva ca | brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraścāṣṭaśaktibhiḥ || 52 ||
pañcabrahma śivāṅgāni prasādānte sadāśivaḥ | śiṣye dehe nyasedvipraḥ praṇavādi namo'ntakam || 53 ||
tattanmantramanusmṛtya yojayet śiṣyadehake | mantrādhvā vinyasenmūrdhni kalādhvā mukhameva ca || 54 ||
tattvādhvā hṛdaye nyasya nābhe tu bhuvanātmakam | varṇādhvā meḍhradeśe tu pādayostu kalādhvakam || 55 ||
padādhvā tu punaryojya pādārabhya śirontakam | sadyaṃ kalābhiraṣṭābhirvāmadevaṃ trayodaśa || 56 ||
aghoramapi cāṣṭau tu caturvṛttastathaiva ca | īśānasya kalāḥ pañca aṣṭatriṃśatkalā nyaset || 57 ||
vidyeśvarāṇāmaṣṭau ca gaṇeśānāṃ catuṣṭayam | prāsādaṃ lokapālānāṃ astrāṇāṃ padamekaḥ || 58 ||
evaṃ padādhvā vinyasya tattvādhvā ca punarnyaset | pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca || 59 ||
śrotraṃ tvak cakṣu jihvā ca ghrāṇaścaiva tu pañcamaḥ | vākpāṇipādapāyūrupasthaṃ caiva tu pañcamam || 60 ||
śabdasparśe rūparase gandhaścāpi ca pañcamam | mano'haṃkārabuddhiśca prakṛtiḥ puruṣastathā || 61 ||
raso māyā ca vidyā ca kālā niyatireva ca | vi (***) barakāśca śuddhamāyā tathaiva ca || 62 ||
śuddhavidyā śuddhakalā sadāśiva śivaḥ paraḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśatattvamevaṃ tu krameṇaiva tu vinyaset || 63 ||
bhuvanādhvā tato nyasya kālaṃ nālā śivāntakam | bhuvanādhvā nyasetpaścāt paścādūrdhvaṃ krameṇa tu || 64 ||
adhasthāddhṛdayādīni kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ | kālāgniścāndhakāraṃ ta narako neka viṃśatiḥ || 65 ||
rauravaṃ kumbhipākaṃ ca mahā (***) eva ca | kṣuradhārāsikādīni jalaṃ ca śītalena ca || 66 ||
uṣṇasantāpanaṃ caiva lohataptaṃ tathaiva ca | kūṭaṃ śālmali kūpaṃ ca tilayantreṣu yantrakam || 67 ||
dhanurnirayamādhānaṃ kṣurikānirayameva ca | pāṣāṇaṃ taptapāṃsurvai dharaṇī ca tathaiva ca || 68 ||
talaṃ ca vitalaṃ caiva nitalaṃ ca talātalam | sutalaṃ ca talātalaṃ rasātalamathopari || 69 ||
bhūlokaśca bhuvarlokassuvarlokastathaiva ca | maharlokaśca vijñeyo janalokastathaiva ca || 70 ||
tapolokaṃ satyalokaṃ gandharvā yakṣalokakaḥ | vidyādharaṇāṃ lokaṃ ca siddhacāraṇalokakān || 71 ||
asurāṇāṃ lokaṃ ca karṇikānāṃ ca lokakam | indulokāgnilokaṃ ca yamo nirṛtilokakama || 72 ||
varuṇaṃ vāyulokaṃ ca somalokaṃ tathaiva ca | īśānaṃ devalokaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ tathaiva ca || 73 ||
brahmalokoparistasya viṣṇulokamataḥparam | ananteśasya lokaṃ tu sūkṣmalokamataḥparam || 74 ||
śivottamasya lokantu ekanetrasya lokakam | ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍi ca || 75 ||
maheśvarasya lokaṃ tu sadāśivasya lokakam | lokaṃ ca śivalokaṃ ca kramameṣāṃ prakīrtitam || 76 ||
śivalokopariṣṭāttu lokamanyanna vidyate | nābhimūlātsamārabhya yāvaddhṛdayadeśikam || 77 ||
varṇādhvā vinyasedviprā kapotāntarameva ca | akāraṃ mūrdhni deśe tu ukāraṃ tu lalāṭake || 78 ||
ukāraṃ dakṣiṇe netre īkāraṃ vāmalocane | ukāraṃ dakṣiṇanāsāyāṃ ūkāraṃ vāmanāsike || 79 ||
ṛkāraṃ dakṣiṇe śrotre ṛkāraṃ vāmakarṇake | ḷkāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe ḷlkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍake || 80 ||
e ai ca tālurandhre tu o au oṣṭhadvayorapi | dantapaṅktidvaye nyasya aṃ aḥ ityakṣaradvayaḥ || 81 ||
kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste cavargaṃ vāmahastake | ṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pāde tavargaṃ vāmapādake || 82 ||
pā pau dakṣiṇapārśve vā vāmapārśve ba bhau nyaset | makāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yakāraṃ tvak ca vinyaset || 83 ||
rephaṃ raktakamevoktaṃ lakāraṃ māṃsamucyate | makāraṃ meda vinyasya cakāraṃ ca sudeśike || 84 ||
majjādeśe ṣakāraṃ tu śakāraṃ śaklameva ca | hakāraṃ prāṇamityāhuḥ kṣakāraṃ meḍhrameva ca || 85 ||
lakāre vṛṣaṇe proktaṃ sarvānyetāni vinyaset | navatriṃśatkalānvipra kādipādāntaṃ vinyaset || 86 ||
rasutārā ramaṇīya tarayaṃ tu sudāruṇī | nivṛttaśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva ca || 87 ||
śāntyatītaṃ paraṃ vyoma kramādvinyasya tattvavit | tato mohā kṣudhā nidrā mṛtyu māya jarā bhayā || 88 ||
rājā rakṣā ratiḥ pālyā ramyākṣaṇamiti kriyā | dhṛtiṃ kāryā parā trī ca bhrāmiṇī mohinī tathā || 89 ||
siddhaṃ ṛddhirdyutirlakṣmī medhā kāṃ tu sthirā sthitaḥ | navatriṃśatkalā hyetā devadeva na dhīmahi || 90 ||
hṛdaye cāgni vinyasya mukhe vāyuśca ta nyaset | ākāśaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya pañca ta kramaṇā nyaset || 91 ||
mantrādhvā sadyamantreṇa vāmenaiva padādhvakam | varṇādhvā cā hyaghoreṇa tattvādhvā puruṣeṇa tu || 92 |
bhuvanādhvā kalādhvā ca īśānena tu vinyaset | evameva krameṇaiva śiṣyadehe nyasettataḥ || 93 ||
īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya mukhe viṣṇuriti smṛtam | hṛdayaṃ brahmaṇā proktaṃ acintyāṃ hastayornyaset || 94 ||
indraścaiva tu kukṣi syādvāmāgnau pārśvayornyaset | vṛṣaṇe nirṛtiścaiva vāyū varuṇa pādayoḥ || 95 ||
pṛṣṭhe candra iti khyātaṃ śiṣya ho tu vinyaset | evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ pūto bhavati mānavaḥ || 96 ||
deśikaścānmanā viprā śivastatraiva tiṣṭhati | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena deśikaḥ pūjayettataḥ || 97 ||
yaddravyaṃ pātraśeṣādi śivasya parameṣṭhinam | hotavyaṃ deśikasyāpi taddoṣāya prakalpayet || 98 ||
śivamuddiśya sarvaṃ tu vastra dhānyādi kāñcanam | dadyādācārya haste tu śivalokamavāpnuyāt || 99 ||

[iti vīratantre dīkṣāvidhipaṭalo navamaḥ] || (?)
