īśvara uvāca(-)
grahābhiṣekaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | śucau deśe samaṃ kṛtvā gomayenānulepayet || 1 ||
śālistasyopari nyasya (*****) ghaṭaṃ nyaset | sasūtrān sāpidhānāṃśca savastrānvāripūritān || 2 ||
pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ sthāpayetkalaśānnava | madhyame sthāpayetkumbhaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayet || 3 ||
kumbhadakṣiṇapārśve tu sthāpayettu navagrahān | ādityaṃ madhyame sthāpya śukraṃ pūrve tu vinyaset || 4 ||
āgneyaṃ candradaivatyaṃ aṅgārakaṃ tu dakṣiṇe | rāhuṃ ca nairṛte bhāge paścime śanirucyate || 5 ||
ketuścaiva tu vāyavyāduttare tu bṛhaspatī | aiśānyā budhadevastu sthāpayetkumbhakaissaha || 6 ||
svasvanāmo tu saṃyuktaṃ hṛdayena samanvitam | arcayeccaiva viprendra havirnivedayettataḥ || 7 ||
bilvapatraṃ tu śiṣyaṃ ca dūrvā caiva palāśakam | viṣṇukrāntiśśamīpatraṃ padmapatraṃ tathaiva ca || 8 ||
vakulārkasya patraṃ ca aśvatthodumbarastathā | karavīraṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ kumbhe caiva tu nikṣipet || 9 ||
gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya pūrvedyuradhivāsayet | evamabhyarcya vidhivat grahapīḍāṃ vyapohya tu || 10 ||
upanayanādikāryeṇa evamevābhiṣecayet | sarve doṣānvinaśyanti evamevaṃ samācaret || 11 ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastradhānyādikāñcanaiḥ | grahābhiṣekamidaṃ proktaṃ śaucamārgavidhiṃ śṛṇu || 12 ||
[iti vīratantre grahābhiṣekavidhirdaśamaḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 8 śaucācamana snānapaṭalaḥ]
pitāmaha mahāprājña yattvayā paricoditam | tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsan || 1 ||
utthāya tattathā prātaḥ maunavratasamanvitaḥ | śrīmān prācīmudīcīṃ vā tattvācāryo viśeṣataḥ || 2 ||
uttarābhimukho vāpi dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ tu vā | navamābhimukhasyaṃ tu malaṃ caiva visarjayet || 3 ||
varjayedasthiviṇmūtravarjanaṃ śirovakuṇḍanam | dakṣiṇena tu hastena mṛdaṃ saṃgrāhayettataḥ || 4 ||
vāme śiśnaṃ gṛhītvā tu kaṇṭhe yajñopavitakam | nadyāṃ vāpi taṭāke vā puṣkare vā hrade'pi vā || 5 ||
śuddhasnāne jalaṃ prāpya ācamye tu yathāvidhiḥ | gade ca daśathā dadyāt mṛdaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ || 6 ||
pañcabhiḥ kṣālayedvāmaṃ kārayetpañcamūrttikāḥ | meḍhre caikamṛdaṃ dadyāt karaṃ pañcaiva kṣālayet || 7 ||
amṛtaṃ phalamātreṇa pādau prakṣālayettataḥ | triḥ prāśyodvidaṃ mṛjya ācamya ca vidhānataḥ || 8 ||
mṛtpiṇḍaṃ ca tridhā kṛtvā hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ | tatpuruṣeṇa tu mantreṇa pūrvaṃ piṇḍaṃ tridhā bhavet || 9 ||
dakṣiṇe ghora mantreṇa uttare vāmamantrataḥ | pūrveṇaiva mṛdaṃ dadyāt astreṇa daśadikṣu vai || 10 ||
dakṣiṇena mṛdā caiva sarvāṅgamupalipya ca | hṛdayena tu sarvāṅgamastramantreṇa lepayet || 11 ||
uttareṇa mṛdā caivā śivatīrthaṃ tu kalpayet | jalamadhye sthitaṃ caiva pañcabrahmeṇa deśikaḥ || 12 ||
tailaṃ cāmalakaṃ yuktamaṅgaṃ lālipya sarvaśaḥ | gomayena punaścaiva upalipya ca snāpayet || 13 ||
mārjayecchiramīśānaṃ puruṣeṇa mukhaṃ tathā | hṛdayaṃ caiva ghoreṇa vāmenāṅguṣṭhameva ca || 14 ||
pādayossadyamantreṇa mārjayeddeśikottamaḥ | vyomavyāpiṃ japettatra mārjayitvā tu mantravit || 15 ||
kalaśamudrāṃ tu badhvā tu prāsādenābhiṣiñcayet | gomayena mṛdā caiva sarvāṅgaṃ lepayeddhṛdā || 16 ||
nābhimātrodake sthitvā ācamya ca vidhānataḥ | triḥ prāśyāpo dvirāmṛjya ūrdhvādhaśca krameṇa ca || 17 ||
aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ ca cakṣuṣī samupaspṛśet | prāṇadvayaṃ ca śrotraṃ ca madhyamāṅgulinā spṛśet || 18 ||
aṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu bāhuṃ caiva spṛśettataḥ | sarvābhiraṅgulībhiśca mūrdhānaṃ caiva saṃspṛśet || 19 ||
dakṣiṇena tu hastena udakaṃ grāhayettataḥ | vāmadevena saṃyuktaṃ sūryaśceti jalaṃ pibet || 20 ||
īśānenā cāgniśceti sāyāhne tu jalaṃ pibet | ācamya vidhinānena īśānena samāyutam || 21 ||
sāvitrīṃ ca bhavettatra sūryasyo vodakaṃ dadet | devānvai tarpayettatra vāmadevena mantrataḥ || 22 ||
ṛṣīṃśca tarpayettatra aghoreṇa tu mantrataḥ | pitrāṇāṃ tarpayettatra sadyamantreṇa deśikaḥ || 23 ||
prāsādena samāyuktaṃ sāvitrīṃ ca śatāṣṭakam | mitrassatyena varcasvī hṛdayena samāyutam || 24 ||
japadvai śirasastatra dhautavastraṃ ca veṣṭayet | ācamye pūrvavattatra soṣṇīṣaṃ cottarīyakam || 25 ||
tīre samatalaṃ kṛtvā hastamāteṇa (***) | sūryamāvāhayettatra ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantrataḥ || 26 ||
pādyamācamanaṃ caiva arghyaṃ tasmai nivedayet | devikena tu tīrthena devān saṃtarpayettataḥ || 27 ||
ākarṣṇe tu ca tīrthena ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva tarpayet | pitṛrṇāṃ caiva pūrveṣāṃ paitrakeṇa tu tarpayet || 28 ||
vimānaṃ praviśettatra puṣpahasto viśeṣataḥ | pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā praviśettu kavāṭakam || 29 ||
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau arcayettu kavāṭakam |
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva hṛdā tadā | pūjayedvidhinā kṛtvā kavasthā tu devatāḥ || 30.5 ||
bhujaṅgaśca padaṅgaśca kavaṭasyādhidevatāḥ | tato garbhagṛhaṃ gatvā śivaṃ praṇamya eva ca || 31.5 ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute nityaṃ sarvapāpādvimucyate | snāne devārcane caiva samādhau ca jape tataḥ || 32.5 ||
bhojane devakārye ca maunaṃ ṣaṭsu vidhīyate | cardite'pyudite sūrye śmaśrukarmaṇi maithune || 33.5 ||
duḥsvapne durjanasparśe snānaṃ ṣaṭsu vidhīyate | snānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ jñeyaṃ vāruṇasnānameva ca || 34.5 ||
āgneyyāṃ divyamevaṃ tu vāyavyaṃ mānasaṃ tathā | vāriṇā snāna kāryaṃ ca vāruṇaṃ snānamucyate || 35.5 ||
āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ sātapaṃ varṣayettataḥ | divyasnānamiti proktaṃ vāyavyaṃ tu rajo bhavet || 36.5 ||
mantre mānasamityuktaṃ pañcasnānaṃ vidhīyate | evameva prakāreṇa kuryādvai deśikottamaḥ || 37.5 ||
snānakarma mayā proktaṃ bhasmasnānamathaśṛṇu || 38 ||
[iti vīratantre śaucācamanasnāna ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 9 bhasmasnānapaṭalaḥ]
bhasmasnānaṃ kathaṃ devaṃ tatsnānaṃ kīdṛśo bhavet | etatsarvaṃ samāsena brūhi me parameśvara || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
bhasmasnānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | bhāsakatvaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ bhāsakābhā śubhasya ca || 2 ||
bhasmanat sarvapāpānāṃ bhasmeti parikīrtitāḥ | kramādgrahāśca bhūtāśca asurā yātudhānakāḥ || 3 ||
piśācā guhyakādyāśca ḍakinyā vividhāstathā | sarva (*) ga samutpannā vyāghra sarva bhayeṣu ca || 4 ||
(?) anyaiścakramukairbhasmasnānena naśyati | āgneyaṃ prathamaṃ caiva dvitīyaṃ mārutaṃ bhavet || 5 ||
tṛtīyaṃ śaivamityuktaṃ caturthaṃ bhogadaṃ bhavet | pañcamaṃ śrīkaraṃ proktaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha || 6 ||
nandā bhadrā ca surabhi suśīlā sumanāstathā | teṣāṃ vargeṣu saṃjñātaṃ gomayaṃ caiva saṃgṛhe (. .) || 7 ||
uttamaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu madhyamaṃ raktamucyate | adhamaṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu anyadvāraṃ tu varjayet || 8 ||
vikaṭāṅgaṃ ca viprendra aṅgahīnaṃ ca varjayet | patitaṃ gomayaṃ grāhya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ || 9 ||
kapilā gomayaṃ caiva uttamottama ucyate | gomayaṃ vāyusaṃbandhaṃ śāntikaṃ brahmamantrakaiḥ || 10 ||
ākāśe grāhayedaṅgairdahet tatpauṣṭikaṃ bhavet | bhūtale patitaṃ yattu prāsādena tu kāmadama || 11 ||
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ | śivāgninā da (**********) pi tuṣaistathā || 12 ||
aṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tu viprendra śikhāmantreṇa deśikaḥ | śuklaṃ ca śirasā caiva daṇḍaṃ vai śikhayā tathā || 13 ||
sadyojātena mantreṇa grāhayettu viśeṣataḥ | sauvarṇamuttamaṃ pātraṃ madhyamaṃ rajataṃ bhavet || 14 ||
adhamaṃ tāmrapātraṃ syāt alābhe mṛṇmayaṃ tathā | alābapātre saṃgrāhya vāmadevena mantrataḥ || 15 ||
etadāgneyamityuktaṃ mārutaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha | aṅge vā tena codbhūtamathanācca dahettataḥ || 16 ||
mārutākhyamiti proktaṃ śaivalakṣaṇamucyate | śivāgniṃ kuṇḍa viprendra sajātaṃ bhasmameva ca || 17 ||
bhogadaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi kulālāṃ dahedyataḥ | etaccaturvidhenoktaṃ śrīkaraṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha || 18 ||
catvāri bhedasaṃyuktaṃ bhasmanā ca viśeṣataḥ | evameva prakāreṇa bhasmanāṃ lepayettataḥ || 19 ||
(**) bhyomasamāyuktaṃ brahmamaṅgena saṃyutam | īśānena tu mantreṇa śivamuddhūlayettataḥ || 20 ||
mukhaṃ tatpuruṣeṇaiva śikhāyā hṛdaye nyaset | bāhubhyāṃ kavacenaiva jaṭharaṃ nābhivāmake || 21 ||
meḍhraṃ caiva tu pṛṣṭhe ca vāmadevena dhūlayet | ūrū ca jānunī caiva sphikau caiva kaṭī tathā || 22 ||
pārśvayorubhayoścaiva pādayorubhayoratha | sadyojātena mantreṇa uddhūlayedviśeṣataḥ || 23 ||
uddhūlayettu sarvāṅgaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | tripuṇḍraṃ kārayettatra nṛpāṇāṃ vaiśya eva ca || 24 ||
śūdrāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāmevameva krameṇa tu | madhyāhnātprāk jalairyuktamatoyādanuvarjayet || 25 ||
sthānabhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūrdhanī lalāṭa eva ca | karṇau ca cakṣuṣī caiva nāsikau cāsya eva ca || 26 ||
(hṛdayeye caiva nābhau ca)
grīvāskandhau ca bāhubhyāṃ koparau ca tathā maṇau | hṛdi nābhau ca meḍhrau ca pāṭhayūrūpajānunī || 27 ||
jaṅghayo svikapātaśca tathā pṛṣṭhau ca eva ca | dvātriṃśasthānamevoktaṃ bhasmanā lepayettataḥ || 28 ||
lalāṭaṃ grīvāskandhau ca bāhukorparayorapi | hṛdaye jaṭhare caiva nābhau pārśve tu pṛṣṭhake || 29 ||
pādayoścaiva viprendra ṣoḍaśasthānamucyate | mūrdhnī caiva lalāṭe ca kaṇṭhe bāhvostathaiva ca || 30 ||
hṛdaye caiva nābhau ca pṛṣṭhe caiva viśeṣataḥ | jānunyoraṣṭasthāneṣu vinyasedbhasmameva ca || 31 ||
brahmā skande ca vighneśaṃ viṣṇuṃ caiva śivaṃ tathā | vasundharā ca pitaro adhidevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 32 ||
ṣaḍaṅgulya ca catvāro stryaṅgulyā vātha cāṅgulā | brahmaṇādīni varṇāni vistāramiva cocyate || 33 ||
strīṇāṃ tathaiva mārgeṇa bhasmanā lepayettataḥ | jñānārthaṃ candanaṃ lipya vaśyārthaścūrṇameva ca || 34 ||
jayārthī caiva viprendra lepayedraktacandanaiḥ | deśikānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ anāmikā madhyatarjanī || 35 ||
bhasmanā lepayettatra sarvapāpātpramucyate | dusvapnavarjanasparśe ānurāṇāṃ tu sarvaśaḥ || 36 ||
bhasmanā tena śuddhyanti rakṣārthamiha cocyate | bhojane tuṣakeśaṃ ca citāṅgāra nakhānyapi || 37 ||
matkuṇaṃ makṣikāścāpi sarīsṛpāṃśca sarvaśaḥ | dadhikṣīraghṛtaistailairmiśrite tu viśeṣataḥ || 38 ||
bhasmāt śuddhimavāpnoti siṃhasyeva yathā gajaḥ | pūrvāhṇe bhojane kāle gamane'pi tathaiva ca || 39 ||
bhasmano dhāraṇaṃ yattu sarvarakṣā vidhīyate | evameva krameṇaiva bhasmaṃ dadyāttu bhaktitaḥ || 40 ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaśśivalokamavāpnuyāt | bhasmasnānaṃ mayā proktaṃ mantranyāsaṃ śṛṇuṣvathā || 41 ||
[iti vīratantre bhasmasnānapaṭalaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 10 mantranyāsavidhiḥ, agnikāryavidhiśca]
pitāmaha uvāca(-)
praṇamya śirasā devamapṛcchacca pitāmahaḥ | mantranyāsaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
yatsarvaṃ tu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ martyānāṃ tu hitāya ca | tava snehādidaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana || 2 ||
śivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kuryānmaṇṭapāddakṣiṇe tataḥ | maṇḍalaṃ caiva viprendra gomayenānulepayet || 3 ||
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūmaṃ ca dīpaṃ caiva samāyutam | pūrvaṃ caiva tu nikṣipya pūrvāgraṃ vidhipūrvakam || 4 ||
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā tatrānte kūrcamadhyame | sadyena prokṣayettatra kuśakūrcena vā tataḥ || 5 ||
gandhapuṣpādinā vipra svadevīṃ pūjayeddhṛdā | śikhāgre dvādaśāṅgulye śivatattvaṃ vicintayet || 6 ||
svātmānaṃ yojayettatra tanmaṃ caiva dahettataḥ | trikoṇaṃ maṇḍale vidyāṃ dvitīyaṃ vicintayet || 7 ||
pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ samārabhya dehedyāvacchiro'ntakam | bhasmībhutamimaṃ dhyātvā amṛtaplāvanaṃ kuru || 8 ||
śikhādhvastapramāṇena ūrdhvaṃ caiva vicintayet | śvetapadmopariṣṭaṃ tu candrabimbamadhomukham || 9 ||
turīyamamṛtaṃ dhyāyet oṃkāreṇa samanvitam | cintayedamṛtaṃ toyaṃ suṣumnābhinnamastakam || 10 ||
tenāplāvitamātmānaṃ pūrayantaṃ vicintayet | mṛtyunāśanamevaṃ tu iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ || 11 ||
paścātsvadehe saṃcintya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet | recakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ ca tridhā matam || 12 ||
na muñcati na gṛhṇāti vāyurantarbahisthitam | āpūrya kumbhakaṃ tiṣṭhedacalaṃ syāttu kumbhakam || 13 ||
evameva prakāreṇa kārayeddeśikottamaḥ | hastābhyāṃ saṃspṛśetpūrvaṃ kādipādāntameva ca || 14 ||
aṅguṣṭhatarjanībhyāṃ tu astramantreṇa saṃyutam | dik vidikṣu ca dātavyaṃ mūrdhā yaścaiva vinyaset || 15 ||
ācāryānu pṛthivī jñeyā sphuyinnābhideśitaḥ | galādvai tejassaṃśuddhi lalāṭādvāyu śudhyati || 16 ||
tadūrdhve dvādaśāṅgulye ghanaśuddhirudāhṛtam | prathamaṃ sṛṣṭi vinyasya sthitinyāsaṃ dvitīyakam || 17 ||
saṃhāraṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ syāttrividhaṃ cocyate mayā | gṛhasthaṃ sṛṣṭimārgeṇa brahmacārī sthito bhavet || 18 ||
vānaprasthayatīnāṃ ca saṃhāranyāsamucyate | aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsamudāhṛtam || 19 ||
īśānādipañcamantrāṇi aṅguṣṭhādīni vinyaset | īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyaset || 20 ||
aghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayet | sadyojātaṃ nyasetpāde punaraṅgāni vinyaset || 21 ||
hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyaset | śikhāṃ śikhāyāṃ vinyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥ || 22 ||
astraṃ hastapradeśe tu netraṃ netreṣu vinyaset | vinyasettu ṣaḍaṅgāni devatānyāsakaṃ śṛṇu || 23 ||
brahmāṇaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya lalāṭe viṣṇurucyate | candrasūryau tu nayane nāsikāṃ pṛthivī tathā || 24 ||
sarasvatīṃ tu vāgdvāre tu hṛdaye īśvaraṃ tathā | haste vai indradaivatyaṃ vāyussyātkukṣireva ca || 25 ||
subrahmaṇyasya liṅge ca pārśvayoraśvinau tathā | pādayormarutaścaiva evameva kramāṃ nyaset || 26 ||
akāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya ākāraṃ tu lalāṭake | ikāraṃ dakṣiṇe netre īkāraṃ vāmalocane || 27 ||
ukāraṃ dakṣiṇanāsāyāṃ ūkāraṃ vāmanāsike | ṛkāraṃ dakṣiṇe śrotre ṛkāraṃ vāmakarṇake || 28 ||
ḷkāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe ḷrkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍake | e ai tālurandhre ca o au oṣṭhadvayorapi || 29 ||
dantapaṅktirdvayornyasya aṃ aḥ dvau parikīrtitau | kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste cavargaṃ vāmahastake || 30 ||
ṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pāde tavargaṃ vāmapādake | papau dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāmapārśve bahau nyaset || 31 ||
makāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yakāraṃ tvaci vinyaset | rephaṃ raktaṃ ca mevoktaṃ lakāramasameva ca || 32 ||
vākāramāsadaivaṃ tu śakāraṃ cāsyadeśike | majjādeśe ṣakāraṃ tu sakāraṃ śuklameva ca || 33 ||
bhakāra prāṇamityāhuḥ kṣakāraṃ meḍhrameva ca | lakāraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ caiva sarvānetān kramānnyaset || 34 ||
sṛṣṭinyāsamiti proktaṃ sthitinyāsamatha śṛṇu | madhyāditaṣṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca pañcabrahma nyasettataḥ || 35 ||
īśānaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva anāmike puruṣaṃ nyaset | kaniṣṭhikāyāṃ ca ghoraṃ syādvāmamaṅguṣṭhake nyaset || 36 ||
sadyojātaṃ tu tarjanyāṃ vinyasedbrahmameva ca | hṛdayaṃ madhyame nyasya śiromantraṃ tvanāmike || 37 ||
śikhā kaniṣṭhike nyasya kavacamaṅguṣṭhake nyaset | netraṃ tu tarjaniṃ nyasya astraṃ karatale nyaset || 38 ||
evaṃ ṣaḍaṅga vinyasya vidyeśānvisettataḥ | anantaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya lalāṭe sūkṣmamucyate || 39 ||
śivottamaṃ mukhe nyasya ekanetraṃ tu karṇayoḥ | (?) ekanetraṃ tu bāhau tu trimūrtiṃ hṛdaye nyaset || 40 ||
liṅge śrīkaṇṭhamityuktaṃ śikhaṇḍī pādayornyaset | hṛdaye hṛdaye nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyaset || 41 ||
śikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥ | astraṃ hastapradeśe tu netraṃ netre tu vinyaset || 42 ||
hastau tu maṇibandhau tu īśaṃ brahmāṇameva ca | sthitinyāsamiti proktaṃ saṃhāraṃ ca hyatha śṛṇu || 43 ||
sadyojātaṃ kaniṣṭhāṃ tu vāmadevamanāmikā | aghoraṃ madhyame nyasya puruṣaṃ tarjanīṃ nyaset || 44 ||
īśamaṅguṣṭhake nyasya ṣaḍaṅgānvinyasettataḥ | hṛdayaṃ kaniṣṭhike nyasya śiromantramanāmike || 45 ||
śikhāmantraṃ tu madhye syāt kavacaṃ tarjanī nyaset | netramaṅguṣṭhake nyasya astraṃ karatale nyaset || 46 ||
pādayossadyamantraṃ tu kukṣau vāmaṃ nyasettataḥ | aghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya mukhe tatpuruṣe nyaset || 47 ||
īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya pādayorhṛdaye nyaset | meḍhraṃ tu śiromantraṃ tu kukṣau śikhāṃ tu vinyaset || 48 ||
kavacaṃ hṛdaye nyasya netraṃ bāhudvayornyaset | mukhe cāstramiti proktaṃ śivamantraṃ tu sarvaśaḥ || 49 ||
indrantu pādayornyasya meḍhraṃ tu pāvake nyaset | yamaṃ kukṣau tu vinyasya nirṛtiṃ hṛdaye nyaset || 50 ||
bāhvorvaruṇadaivatyaṃ kaṇṭhe vāyuriti smṛtam | mukhe tu somadaivatyamīśānaṃ śirasi nyaset || 51 ||
evameva kramaṃ jñātvā vinyaseddeśikassadā | ācāryastvādi śaivassyādgrahastho vā dvijottamaḥ || 52 ||
sṛṣṭisthitikaṃ saṃhāraṃ nyāsaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | evaṃ nyastvā vidhānena deśikāścāpi bhāvayet || 53 ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpādyaissvadehaṃ pūjayeddhṛdā | dvārapālānsamabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādinā saha || 54 ||
pūrve ca dvārapālau tu nandikālastathaiva ca | dakṣiṇadvārapālau tu daṇḍī muṇḍīstathaiva ca || 55 ||
paścimadvārapālau tu kirīṭī vijayastathā | uttaradvārapālau tu anantapaśupatistathā || 56 ||
nandiṃ tu dakṣiṇe sthāpya śyāmavarṇasamanvitam | daṇḍahastasamāyuktaṃ huṃkāraṃ mantramucyate || 57 ||
kālaṃ kuṅkumavarṇābhaṃ uttare tu pratiṣṭhitam | vaṭavṛkṣāyudhairyuktaṃ mantra hiṃkārameva ca || 58 ||
daṇḍiṃ pūrve tu vinyasya indrakopasya sannibhaḥ | khaḍgāyata samāyukto hrauṃkāraṃ mantramucyate || 59 ||
daṇḍī tu paścime nyasya śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ | bhiṇḍipālasamāyuktaṃ hrūṃkāraṃ mantramucyate || 60 ||
bhṛṅgīriṭiṃ dakṣiṇe tu durddhūvagrīva sannibhaḥ | śaktyāyu samaṃ yuktaṃ mantraṃ hruṃkāramucyate || 61 ||
vijayaṃ caivottare sthāpya raktavarṇasamāyutam | śūlāyudhasamāyuktaṃ hraṃkāraṃ mantramucyate || 62 ||
anantaṃ paścime sthāpya kanakābhaṃ tathaiva ca | vajrāyudhasamāyuktaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ mantramucyate || 63 ||
paśupatiḥ pūrvatassthāpya nīlarūpasamanvitam | pāśāyudhasamāyuktaṃ hrīṃkāraṃ mantramucyate || 64 ||
evameva kramātsthāpya etairmantraiśca pūjayet | sarvāṃśca caturbhujāṃścaiva triṇetreṇaiva saṃyutān || 65 ||
sarvānṛjvāgatā sthitvā krūradṛṣṭīn bhayāvahān | makuṭaiḥ kuṇḍalairyuktān prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ || 66 ||
uktakramaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā abhyukṣya kavacena tu | tisraḥ pūrvamukhā rekhā udagrekhāṃ tathaiva ca || 67 ||
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca dakṣiṇodyadhidevatāḥ | arcayedgandhapuṣpaiśca hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ || 68 ||
araṇyudbhavate vātha suryakānto bhavaṃ tu vā | śrotriyasyāgnihotreṇa yajana jātavedasam || 69 ||
arīṃ caiva ca viprendra ṣoḍaśāṅguladairghyakam | vistāraṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulyaṃ viṣkambhaṃ tu triyaṅgulam || 70 ||
śamīpippalapatraṃ ca kārayedaraṇī tataḥ | mayitvā pañcabrahmeṇa pātraṃ vinyasya deśikaḥ || 71 ||
tadagniṃ sarvakāryeṣu upanayanādi kāryake | hṛdā cāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya agnyādhānaṃ tu kārayet || 72 ||
agnyādhānamupasthānaṃ paristaraṇameva ca | pātrāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ caiva prokṣaṇīṃ prokṣaṇīṃ tathā || 73 ||
kūrcādhānaṃ praṇītā ca ghṛtasaṃskārameva ca | idhmaṃ praveśanaṃ cāpi tattanmantreṇa deśikaḥ || 74 ||
prāsādena tu mantreṇa upasthānaṃ tu kārayet | agnau kāṣṭhaṃ vinikṣipya śikhāmantreṇa deśikaḥ || 75 ||
paristaraṇaṃ punaḥ kuryāt pragagraṃ cottarāgrakaḥ | kuśairnaiva paristīrya pūrve tu cottarāgrakam || 76 ||
tadūrdhvadarbhā nāstīrya paścime cottarāgrakam | uttare pūrvamūrdhnī vinyaseddeśikassadā || 77 ||
paridhīnvinyasettatra dakṣiṇe paścimottare | ūrdhva samidha dvayaṃ caiva āgneyyāmīśadeśake || 78 ||
madhyamaṃ caiva saṃsthāpya vāgīśaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ | ṛtusnānaṃ ca saṃkalpya yonimārgeṇa jāyate || 79 ||
hṛdayenāhutīssapta garbhādhānaṃ bhavanti cet | (?) tatpuruṣeṇa puṃsavanaṃ bhavanti vai || 80 ||
śiromantreṇa viprendra samantātsaptabhiryate | vāmadevena mantreṇa jātakarmaṃ ca hūyate || 81 ||
ekahṛdayaṃ tripādaṃ ca dvivaktraṃ ca dvināsikam | catuśśṛṅgasamāyuktaṃ ṣaṇṇetreṇa samanvitam || 82 ||
saptajihvā saptahastā upavītasamanvitam | jaṭāmauñjīsamāyuktaṃ kṛṣṇājina samanvitam || 83 ||
hiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇā caiva tu suprabhā | atiraktā bahurūpā saptajihvā prakīrtitā || 84 ||
hiraṇye varuṇe jihvā kanakā madhyame sthitā | uttarottaramākhyātaṃ yāmyā kṛṣṇe iti smṛtāḥ || 85 ||
suprabhā pūrvadeśe tu atiraktāgnau vyavasthitā | īśāne bahurūpā ca saptajihvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 86 ||
kanakākhyāyāṃ jihvāyāṃ sarpahomaṃ tu kārayet | jātakarmamidaṃ proktaṃ nāmakaraṇaṃ hṛdayena tu || 87 ||
niṣkrāmaṇaṃ tu śirasā prāsādaṃ hṛdayena tu | caulaṃ śikhāya kartavyaṃ upanayanaṃ hṛdayena tu || 88 ||
vratānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śirasā caiva hūyate | hṛdayena tu mantreṇa samāvartavivāhakaḥ || 89 ||
pṛthak pṛthak kriyāṇāṃ ca sapta vai vāhutirbhavet | dakṣiṇe brahmasthānaṃ ca darbhāsanopari nyaset || 90 ||
praṇītāmuttare sthāpya sapavitrasamāyutam | viṣṇustatrādhidaivatyaṃ gandhapuṣpādinārcayet || 91 ||
prokṣaṇīpātramādāya udakaṃ secayeddhṛdā | kuśenaiva tu viprendra udako plāvanaṃ kuru || 92 ||
praṇītāpātramādāya udakaṃ secayeddhṛdā | utplīvanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt praṇavenaiva nikṣipeta || 93 ||
ājyapātraṃ samādāya ājyaṃ caiva tu pūrayet | agneruttarabhāge tu aṅgāroparinyaset || 94 ||
svadeśe vinyasettatra darbheṇotpavanaṃ kuru | ājyādhiśravaṇaṃ kāryaṃ darbhānagnau vinikṣipet || 95 ||
darbhānagnau ca prajvālya prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ | sruvaṃ caiva tu viprendra kṣālayeddhṛdayena tu || 96 ||
kuśenaiva samāyuktaṃ agramagreṇa vinyaset | madhyaṃ madhyena saṃspṛśya mūlaṃ mūlena saṃspṛśet || 97 ||
prokṣayedambhasā caiva pariṣecanaṃ tu kārayet | adite'numanyasveti dakṣiṇe pariṣiñcati || 98 ||
anumate'numanyasveti paścime pariṣiñcati | sarasvate'numanyasveti uttare pariṣiñcati || 99 ||
deva savitaḥ prasave samantāt pariṣiñcati | palāśa samidhā caiva idhmāṣṣoḍaśameva ca || 100 ||
kṛṣṇamidhmaṃ tu dātavyaṃ ghoraṃ caiva tu hūyate | prajāpate svāheti dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhake || 101 ||
agnimukhaṃ ca hotavyaṃ pañcabrahmeṇa mantravit | evameva krameṇaiva hotavyaṃ dīrghajīvinā || 102 ||
nityahomaṃ ca dātavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam | agnimarcayate caiva ājye cānnena saṃyutam || 103 ||
(?) prāsādena tu visyāṃti homayet na śatāhutiḥ | (?) gerivajo tadvarca pañcabrahma śivāṅgake || 104 ||
vidyeśvarāṃśca mantrāṃśca lokapālān sahasrakaiḥ | homayeccaiva viprendra nityahomamihocyate || 105 ||
punaḥ pariṣecanaṃ kṛtvā nityotsavamathācaret | varṇāni gandhaśabdāni lakṣayeccaiva deśikaḥ || 106 ||
ādityodayapūrṇābhaṃ padmarāgasamaprabham | raktapaṅkajasaṃkāśaṃ kiṃśukasya samaprabham || 107 ||
ete dvādaśa varṇāni jātavedāstu siddhidaḥ | uśīraṃ kuṣṭhagandhaṃ ca karpūrāgarumeva ca || 108 ||
candanaṃ cāti takkolaṃ kaṭukastuṭireva ca | patraṃ kusumabandhaṃ ca śubhānyetāni nirdiśet || 109 ||
śikhāyāṃ lakṣayettatra pūrva caivārthasiddhidaḥ | vāruṇe śāntikaṃ proktaṃ saumyāyāṃ mṛtyunāśanam || 110 ||
ūrdhve tu sarvakāmārthaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | āgneyamagnidaṇḍaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ caiva tu yāmyake || 111 ||
nairṛtyāṃ yuddhamaraṇaṃ vāyavyāṃ kalahaṃ bhavet | īśānyāmājñalābhoya śikhāniṣkrāntalakṣaṇam || 112 ||
kāka dhvani te śabdaṃ māsānmaraṇamāpnuyāt | ulūka dhvani te vahni āgamyāgamanaṃ bhavet || 113 ||
piṅgala dhvani te vahni nṛpasya maraṇaṃ bhavet | vaṭa dhvani yute vahniḥ svaputramaraṇaṃ bhavet || 114 ||
vṛṣabha dhvani te vahni āgamyāgamanaṃ bhavet | aśani dhvani te vahni ṣaṇmāsānmaraṇaṃ bhavet || 115 ||
kharavaddhvanane vahni apamṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ | kaṭibhirdhvani te vahnirmāryāyā maraṇaṃ bhavet || 116 ||
ghoravat bhavate śabdaṃ svadravyaṃ taskaraprabham | samudraghoṣavat śabdaṃ māsānmaraṇamāpnuyāt || 117 ||
(?) gogavadhvani te vahni (kārāgṛhamavāpnuyāt) sarveṣāṃ maraṇaṃ bhavet | jhallarīva bhavet śabda caṇḍālagamanaṃ bhavet || 118 ||
bhāṇḍavaddhvanite śabdaḥ viṣūcyā maraṇaṃ bhavet | agnigandho bhavedagni kṣayarogamavāpnuyāt || 119 ||
hiṅgugandhaṃ bhavedagniṃ pramehaṃ caiva jāyate | atigandhaṃ bhavedagnirmahājvaramavāpnuyāt || 120 ||
medhyagandhaṃ bhavedagnirbhaṅgaṃ maraṇaṃ bhavet | mūtragandhaṃ bhavedagniḥ kukṣiṃ rogamavāpnuyāt || 121 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena lakṣaleddeśikassadā | śubhāśubhaṃ mayā proktamagnidevasya padmajam || 122 ||
grahaṇādyuktakāleṣu pratiṣṭhādimuhūrtake | pariṣecana kuryāttu taddoṣa śamanāya ca || 123 ||
homaṃ kuryāttu viprendra lakṣaṇena samanvitam | samidājyacarun lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilān || 124 ||
prāsādena tu mantreṇa pañcāśatsamidhaṃ hunet | hṛdayenājyahomaṃ tu calaṃ ca śikhayā hunet || 125 ||
jālamānena mantreṇa sarṣapaṃ sadyamantrataḥ | aghoreṇa yavāhutvā kavacena tilānapi || 126 ||
saptadravyeṇa hotavyaṃ pañcāśatāhutiṃ tathā | sarvadravyasamāyuktaṃ havyavāhaṃ samuccaran || 127 ||
sviṣṭamagnetimantreṇa juhuyāttadanantare | hutvānte tu yadasyeti sviṣṭakṛccaiva hūyate || 128 ||
pūrveśa dakṣiṇe caiva paścime cottare tathā | īśānyāṃ caiva hotavyaṃ kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vā || 129 ||
evaṃ kṛte mahāśānti rājarāṣṭrasukhāvaham | indradhanuśca dṛṣṭaścettaddoṣa śamanāya ca || 130 ||
evameva krameṇaiva anyairdoṣaiśca saṃbhavet | ācāryapūjanaṃ kṛtvā vastrāṅgulīyakādibhiḥ || 131 ||
agnikāryaṃ mayā proktaṃ nityotsava tataśśṛṇu || 131.5 ||
[iti vīratantre agnikāryapaṭalaḥ] (?) (mantranyāsavidhiḥ, agnikāryavidhiśca)
[paṭalaḥ 11 nityotsavavidhiḥ]
pitāmaha uvāca(-)
lokanāthaṃ praṇamyātha brahmā vacanamabravīt | nityotsavaṃ kathaṃ deva tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi nityotsavaviśeṣataḥ | sarvapāpahāraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvalokahitāvaham || 2 ||
sarvaśāntikaraṃ caiva sarvāriṣṭavināśanam | nityanityārcanante tu nityotsavamathācaret || 3 ||
rākṣasāścāsurāścaiva piśācā brahmarākṣasāḥ | ucchiṣṭāścaiva vetālā kūśmāṇḍā hata (***) || 4 ||
tathā kumāra grahāṃścaiva matāṃścānye marudgaṇāḥ | nityotsavaśca śabdāṃśca śrutvā gacchanti tatra vai || 5 ||
prathamaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ vipra tava prītikarāya vai | dvitīya pradakṣiṇenaiva mama prītikarāya vai || 6 ||
tṛtīya pradakṣiṇaṃ caiva viṣṇu prītikarāya ca | pūrvāhnī ca tava prītiḥ puṣpa liṅgasamanvitam || 7 ||
madhyāhne cānnaliṅgaṃ ca mama prītikaraṃ bhavet | sāye taṇḍulaliṅgaṃ syāt nārāyaṇa priyaṃ tathā || 8 ||
sthitaliṅgaṃ tu viprendra śrībaliṃ caiva kārayet | calaliṅgeṣu sarveṣu śrībaliṃ ca prakārayet || 9 ||
(?) āḍhakārddhīna vaiśyaṃ śrīśrībaliṃ ca na kārayet | evameva krameṇaivaṃ nityotsavaṃ tu kārayet || 10 ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmrakāṃsyaṃ ca naiva ca | balipātraṃ tu kartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam || 11 ||
mātrāṅgulena kartavyaṃ dvitālamuttamaṃ bhavet | ekatālena hīnaṃ tu madhyamaṃ pātramucyate || 12 ||
dvayaṅgulena hīnaṃ tu madhyamaṃ pātramucyate | pātraṃ caiva tridhā bhajya madhye pātraṃ tu kārayet || 13 ||
oṣṭhavyo māṅgulenaiva kārayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ | padmasyotsedhamānaṃ tu ekāṅgulamihocyate || 14 ||
aṣṭapatrasamāyuktaṃ vidyeśā hyatra devatāḥ | evameva krameṇaiva balipātraṃ tu kārayet || 15 ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena caruṃ caiva tu vā caret | dviprasthamadhamaṃ proktaṃ āḍhakaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet || 16 ||
uttamaṃ śivamevāhuḥ śālīnāṃ caiva pā(vā?) caret | atyuṣṇamati śītaṃ ca ājyaṃ lavaṇavarjitam || 17 ||
pāṣāṇaṃ pādhitaṃ caiva śodhakaṃ tuṣameva ca | kaṇakambu samāyuktaṃ māraṇaṃ tu vinirdiśet || 18 ||
evameva kramaṃ jñātvā pācayedvidhipūrvakaḥ | śivāgre maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā maṇṭapasyottarā diśi || 19 ||
gomayenopalipyātha baliṃ pātraṃ nyaseddhṛdā | prokṣayedastramantreṇa kuśenaiva tu vāriṇā || 20 ||
caruṃ vai hṛdayenaiva balipātraṃ tu vinyaset | kṣīraṃ vā dadhisaṃyuktaṃ ājyenaiva samāyutam || 21 ||
kadalīgulasaṃmiśraṃ annaliṅgaṃ tu kārayet | aṣṭāṅgulaṃ tu cotsedhā dviguṇaṃ tasya mūlakam || 22 ||
agramaṣṭāṅgulaṃ nāhamuttamaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ | dvādaśāṅgulamutsedha dviguṇaṃ mūlanāhakam || 23 ||
agraṃ daśāṅgulaṃ nāhamannaliṅgamihocyate | tryakṣaṃ caturbhujaṃ devamūrdhvakeśaṃ sudaṃṣṭrakam || 24 ||
dakṣiṇe tu kare śūlaṃ vāme pāśaṃ tathaiva ca | abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāmahastaṃ kuṭispṛśam || 25 ||
padmamadhye sthitaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | evaṃ vai rūpiṇaṃ dhyātvā bali liṅge tu vinyaset || 26 ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaiva supūjayet | gandhaṃ hṛdayamantreṇa śikhāyāṃ puṣpamucyate || 27 ||
sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmramāyasaṃ vāpi kārayet | hastamātraṃ bhaveddaṇḍamagre vajradvayaṃ bhavet || 28 ||
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | prokṣayedambhasā caiva hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ || 29 ||
īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya mukhe tatpuruṣaṃ nyaset | aghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayet || 30 ||
sadyojātaṃ nyasetpādau punaraṅgāni vinyaset | hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraśśirasi vinyaset || 31 ||
śikhāṃ śikhāyāṃ vinyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥ | astraṃ hastapradeśe tu netre netraṃ tu vinyaset || 32 ||
sarvāṅgeṣu ca viprendra astramantraṃ nyasettataḥ | sthālikāṃ caiva coddhṛtya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ || 33 ||
śiromantreṇa saṃyuktaṃ tasyāṃ śirasi nikṣipet | japetpāśupatāstraṃ ca śargaiścetpradakṣiṇam || 34 ||
nimiṣaṃ tanna śīghraṃ ca gacchet padātpadaṃ tataḥ | purastātpratimaṃ gacchet liṅgaṃ tu tadanuvrajet || 35 ||
āyaṃ tu pṛṣṭhato vāpi pādukaṃ ca pradettataḥ | śivasyābhimukhe caiva gomayenānulepayet || 36 ||
bherīṃ tatraiva vinyasya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ | gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya vādyakaṃ pūjayettataḥ || 37 ||
vādyakān vādayettatra pañcadhvanisamāyutam | suṣiraṃ cānakhaṃ caiva carmabhedaṃ tathaiva ca || 38 ||
taṃ tritaṃ taṃ tato vādyaṃ pañcadhvanirihocyate | evaṃ vidhi samāyuktaṃ vādyakān vādayettataḥ || 39 ||
prathamaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt aṃgīrṇaṃ tālavādyakam | dvitīyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt aṣṭatālasamanvitam || 40 ||
pūrve tu samahastaṃ syāt āgneyāṃ bhṛṅgiṇī tathā | dakṣiṇe kadravādyaṃ syānnairṛtyāṃ saṃkarī tathā || 41 ||
vāruṇyāmutkaṭaṃ caiva vāyavyāṃ kubjatālakam | taṭaprahāraṃ saumyāyāṃ aiśānyāṃ mallatālakam || 42 ||
gopure vādyaniśśabdaṃ śaṅkhadhvanisamāyutam | bāhyapīṭhe kramāvṛtya prāsādaṃ tripradakṣiṇam || 43 ||
trividhaṃ balipīṭhaṃ syāt pūrvataścaiva dakṣiṇe | paścime vā trisandhyāyāṃ pradakṣiṇamathācaret || 44 ||
pūrvāhne pūrvapīṭhe tu madhyāhne dakṣiṇe tathā | sāyāhne paścime caiva balimevaṃ visarjayet || 45 ||
athavā cāgrapīṭhe tu dakṣiṇe balirucyate | sarvadvāre tu kartavyaṃ pūrve tu balipīṭhakam || 46 ||
indrasya balitālaṃ tu āgnermadhyāvanaṃ bhavet | yamaṃ ca bhṛṅgiṇītālaṃ nairṛtyā mallatālakam || 47 ||
vāruṇyāṃ navatālaṃ tu vāyavyāṃ nāgatālakam | some kāṭṭārikā proktā īśānyāṃ kakarī tathā || 48 ||
evameva krameṇaiva prāsādaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam | pūrve gāndhārameva syāt dakṣiṇe kauśikaṃ tathā || 49 ||
paścime kamaraṃ caiva tarkarāgaṃ tathottare | āgneyāṃ caiva kollī ca nairṛtyāṃ naṭabhāṣayā || 50 ||
takkeśiṃ caiva vāyavyāṃ cālā prāṇīśa gocare | dvāradeśamanuprāpya pādukārcanamārabhet || 51 ||
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā pādukāṃ pūjayettataḥ | devasya sannidhau vidvān maṇḍalaṃ kārayettataḥ || 52 ||
tripādaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya vṛṣabhasyādhidaivatam | pādukaṃ vinyasettatra prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ || 53 ||
nirmālyaṃ ca visarjīta jalamevābhiṣecayet | hṛdayena tu mantreṇa gandhaṃ dadyācca pāduke || 54 ||
prokṣayedambhasā caiva kṛśāssarvadeśikā | puṣpaṃ tu śirasā caiva dhūmaṃ vāmena dāpayet || 55 ||
aghoreṇa tu dīpaṃ syāt sadyenārghyaṃ tu dāpayet | arcayetpādukāṃ vidvān (**********) dvayoḥ || 56 ||
pātraṃ caiva tu pūrve tu dharaṇīṃ dakṣiṇena tu | pṛthivīṃ paścime nyasya medinīṃ cottare nyaset || 57 ||
vāme jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī kalivikaraṇī tathā | balavikarṇīṃ balapramathinīṃ sarvabhūtamanonmanī || 58 ||
pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasedaṣṭaśaktibhiḥ | manonmanīṃ nyasetmatsye(dhye) acaryadgandhapuṣpakaiḥ || 59 ||
praviśedālayaṃ tatra vinyasetpūrvamaṇḍale | visarjayettu śāstreṇa namaskṛtvā tu kārayet || 60 ||
tadante kārayennṛttaṃ bharatoktena mārgataḥ | gaṇikāssnāpayettatra gandhapuṣpādinārcayet || 61 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ nṛttaṃ bhāvayedgaṇikā tataḥ | nṛttasyānte tu viprendra devaṃ devīṃ visarjayet || 62 ||
abhimukhīkaraṇaṃ yattu tadā vāhanamucyate | pūjāparisamāpte tu vimukhaṃ tadvisarjayet || 63 ||
pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā namaskārastathaiva ca | liṅge savyāpasavyaṃ tu prāsādiṣu visarjayet || 64 ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaśśivalokamavāpnuyāt | paryaṣṭiparicāraśca tato nyāse vitāśanaḥ || 65 ||
śivalokamavāpnoti śivavanmādane sadā | nityotsavamidaṃ proktaṃ parivāraśśṛṇuṣvatha || 66 ||
[iti vīratantre nityotsavavidhiḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 12 parivāralakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ]
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ pṛcchatī sa pitāmahaḥ | parivārāḥ kathaṃ devaṃ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
yatsarvaṃ tu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana | parivāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvidhipurassaram || 2 ||
antarmaṇḍalake kuryāt deśe caṇḍeśvarālayam | purato vṛṣabhasthānaṃ sthāpayedvṛṣabhaṃ tataḥ || 3 ||
āgneyāṃ caiva deśe tu durgāṃ sthāpya viśeṣataḥ | dakṣiṇe mātṛdevīṃśca vighneśaṃ nairṛte tathā || 4 ||
vāruṇyāṃ sthāpayettatra kumāraṃ vāpyajaṃ bhavet | jyeṣṭhāṃ vāyavyadeśe tu viṣṇuṃ cottaradeśataḥ || 5 ||
aiśānyāṃ caiva viprendra bhāskaraṃ vinyasettataḥ | evamantarahāre tu vinyasedaṣṭadaivatān || 6 ||
idamanyatprakāreṇa vakṣye'haṃ caturānana | paścime dvāradehasya paścime vṛṣabhaṃ nyaset || 7 ||
vāyavyāṃ caiva jyeṣṭhā ca sarvayatnena deśikaḥ | uttarāyāṃ diśayoścaiva durgādevīṃ ca vinyaset || 8 ||
aiśānyāṃ caiva viprendra kṣetrapālo vidhīyate | pūrve tu bhāskarasthānaṃ kumāraṃ cāgnigocare || 9 ||
dakṣiṇadvāragehasya dakṣiṇaṃ vṛṣabhālayam | mātṛsthānaṃ tu nairṛtyāṃ subrahmaṇyaṃ tu vāruṇe || 10 ||
jyeṣṭhāṃ tu vāyudeśe tu uttare viṣṇurucyate | durgāṃ caṇḍeśa digbhāge bhāskaraṃ pūrvato nyaset || 11 ||
āgneyyāṃ gaṇapatisthānaṃ vinyaseddaivatāni ja | uttaradvāragehasya uttare vṛṣabhālayam || 12 ||
aiśānyāṃ bhāskarasyaiva pūrvato viṣṇurucyate | durgāmāgneya digbhāge yāmye mātṛgaṇā sthitāḥ || 13 ||
nairṛtyāṃ vighnarājaṃ tu kumāraṃ vāruṇe bhavet | vāyavyāṃ vinyasejjyeṣṭhāṃ viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ || 14 ||
evameva krameṇaiva antarhāre tu vinyaset | ṣoḍaśadvāradevāṃśca vakṣyāmi munisattama || 15 ||
maryādau īśadigbhāge kṣetrapālaṃ suvinyaset | yamanairṛtayormadhye pitṛsthānaṃ vidhīyate || 16 ||
nirṛtivaruṇayormadhye apsarogaṇamucyate | varuṇavāyavyayormadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ sthānamucyate || 17 ||
vāyavyasomayormadhye vasūnaṣṭau ca vinyaset | somīśānayormadhye aṣṭanāgān prakalpayet || 18 ||
indrīśānayormadhye dvādaśādityamucyate | evameva prakāreṇa maryādau ca vidhiṃ nyaset || 19 ||
antarmaṇḍalake vāpi mahāmaryādau viśeṣataḥ | indrādīn sthāpayedvipra pūrvādīśāntaṃ vinyaset || 20 ||
anantamīśadigbhāge saṃsthāpyaṃ nirṛtau tathā | evameva prakāreṇa parivārāṇi vinyaset || 21 ||
prāsādāhitamāśritya maṇṭape vā viśeṣataḥ | dvāradevāṃ susaṃsthāpya pūrvādikramayogataḥ || 22 ||
pūrvavaddvārapāle tu nandīkālastathaiva ca | nandiṃ tu dakṣiṇe sthāpya kālaṃ cottaradeśake || 23 ||
dakṣiṇadvārapālau tu daṇḍirmuṇḍistathaiva ca | daṇḍiṃ tu paścime sthāpya muṇḍiṃ tu pūrvato nyaset || 24 ||
paścimadvārapālau tu bhṛṅgiṇīṃ vijayaṃ tathā | bhṛṅgiṇī cottare sthāpya dakṣiṇe vijayaṃ tathā || 25 ||
uttare dvārapālau tu anantaḥ paśupatistathā | anantaṃ pūrvata sthāpya paśupatiṃ paścime nyaset || 26 ||
evameva prakāreṇa sthāpayeddvāradevatāḥ | vṛṣabhasyāgrato vāpi pṛṣṭhato'tha viśeṣataḥ || 27 ||
śūlasthānaṃ prakalpyātha tadagre puṣpapīṭhake | (***) mamāvyādau va sthāpayettu śivāgrataḥ || 28 ||
mahāmaryāmahāpīṭhe sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥ | parivāravidhiḥ proktaṃ rakṣādīpaṃ śṛṇuṣvathā || 29 ||
[iti vīratantre parivāralakṣaṇaḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 13 rakṣādīpapaṭalaḥ]
pitāmaha uvāca(-)
praṇamya śirasā devī paryapṛcchat pitāmahaḥ | rakṣādīpaṃ kathaṃ devaṃ tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
yattvayā paripṛṣṭaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ śṛṇu padmajaḥ | rakṣādīpaṃ viśeṣeṇa trividhaṃ cocyate mayā || 2 ||
śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva kāmadaṃ ca tridhā bhavet | sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi tāmrajaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ tu vā || 3 ||
sthalikaṃ ca prakartavyaṃ triṃśadaṅgulavistaram | pūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva paścimaṃ cottaraṃ tathā || 4 ||
madhyame tu samāyuktaṃ pañca kumbhāni vinyaset | aṣṭabandhasamutsedhaṃ vistaraṃ dvādaśaṃ bhavet || 5 ||
kumbhordhve dīpa vinyasya śilpinaṃ kārayettataḥ | pādaṃ caiva daśāṅgulyamutsedhaṃ tu vidhīyate || 6 ||
vistāraṃ tāvadevāhurdīpapātraṃ ca kārayet | (*****) saṃyojya rakṣādīpaṃ tu kārayet || 7 ||
etat śāntidamityuktaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha | vistāraṃ tu caturviṃśat aṅgulā sthalikā bhavet || 8 ||
śālipiṣṭaṃ vā vinyasya (*) sapapātrake (**) | teṣāmūrdhve tu (**********) tathā || 9 ||
etat (***) mityuktaṃ trividhaṃ cocyate mayā | nityanityārcane kuryāt tasyāṃ taddīpamucyate || 10 ||
sāyāhne śayane kuryāt yakṣeśvarīṃ ca pūjayet | nityāgnikuṇḍaṃ viprendra (*****) dīpayet || 11 ||
tasya dakṣiṇabhāge tu maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakam | sthālikāṃ vinyasettatra śikhāmantreṇa saṃyutam || 12 ||
goghṛtena samāyuktamavā tailena vā punaḥ | vartiṃ tatraiva vinyasya sannidhau dīpayettataḥ || 13 ||
prāsādena tu mantreṇa madhyame dīpamucyate | pūrṇena puruṣeṇaiva aghoraṃ dakṣiṇena tu || 14 ||
sadyaḥ paścimato nyasya vāmadevaṃ tu cottare | vyomavyāpi sama (**) pañcabrahmeṇa saṃyutam || 15 ||
pūjayettu viśeṣeṇa śirasopari dhārayet | gaṇikāṃ devadāsī vā dhārayeddīpamuttamam || 16 ||
madhukeyasamāyuktaṃ gaṇikāṃ nṛttasaṃyutam | sarvamaṅgalasaṃyuktaṃ śaṅkhadhvanisamāyutam || 17 ||
bherīmṛdaṅgavādyaiśca stotraśabdasamanvitam | gacchetpradakṣiṇaṃ tatra ninayet śivasannidhau || 18 ||
tripādīṃ madhyate nyasya prokṣayet śuddhavāriṇā | īśānena tu mantreṇa arcayeddīpameva ca || 19 ||
puṣpeṇa dīpaṃ saṃyojya liṅgamūrdhnī ca varttayet | ekaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vāpi pradakṣiṇamathācaret || 20 ||
visarjayettu nirmālyaṃ bāhyapīṭhe tu vinyaset | etat śāntikamityuktaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ ca matha śṛṇu || 21 ||
śivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kuryāt tripādaṃ tatraiva vinyaset | vinyaset sthālikāṃ tatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ || 22 ||
piṣṭaṃ vāmena saṃsthāpya prokṣayettu hṛdā tathā | garbhagehe sthite dīpe vartiṃ saṃyojayettataḥ || 23 ||
pūjayedastramantreṇa prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ | hṛdayena tu mantreṇa dīpaṃ dadyāt śivasya tu || 24 ||
ekaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vāpi liṅgaṃ caiva pradakṣiṇam | visarjayettato mantrī bhasmaṃ śirasi nikṣipet || 25 ||
śivasya rakṣo kurvīta sarvaprāṇihitāya ca | evaṃ pauṣṭikamevaṃ tu kāmadaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ || 26 ||
agnikuṇḍe'thavā kuryāt garbhagehe'thavā punaḥ | saptapātraika viprendra dīpaṃ saṃyojayettataḥ || 27 ||
pauṣṭikasya krameṇaiva kuryādvai deśikottamaḥ | śive dīpaṃ susaṃyojya visarjayetpūrvavatkramāt || 28 ||
evaṃ kāmadamityuktaṃ samāsātkathayāmite | uttamaṃ dīpamākhyātaṃ saptāṅgulasamucchrayam || 29 ||
pañcāṅgulaṃ tu madhyaṃ syāttriyaṅgulamathocyate | uttamaṃ goghṛtenaiva madhyamaṃ ajasaṃbhave || 30 ||
adhamaṃ tailajaṃ vāpi sūtrapātaṃ tu kārayet | dūrvākṣataiśca saṃyuktaṃ darpaṇaṃ bhasmameva ca || 31 ||
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpakam | dīpasya darśanaṃ mūrdhni śive dadyāt viśeṣataḥ || 32 ||
yakṣeśvarīsvarūpaṃ tu śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | yāntenaiva samāyuktaṃ ikārasvarasaṃyutam || 33 ||
oṃkārādi namo'ntaṃ ca madhye yakṣeśabījakam | etanmantraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ stavastrotraprakāśikam || 34 ||
dvibhujaṃ caikavaktraṃ ca dvipādaṃ ca dvinetrakam | karaṇḍamakuṭaṃ yuktaṃ saumyarūpaṃ sulocanam || 35 ||
dīpamadhye nyaseddevīmañjalyā ca namaskṛtvā | evaṃvidhaṃ svarūpaṃ tu dhyātvā vai pūjayettataḥ || 36||
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī kalavikaraṇī tathā | (?) balavikaraṇīṃ balapramathanīṃ sarvabhūtadamanīṃ manonmanīm || 37 ||
pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ | madhye manonmanīṃ nyasya pūjayeddevabāhyataḥ || 38 ||
someśānasamāyuktaṃ tadbāhye pūjayettataḥ | evameva krameṇaiva svasvarnāmena pūjayet || 39 ||
bhasmaṃ dadyāt śive ttatra kramāccheṣa samācaret | sāyāhne śayanaṃ kuryādevameva krameṇa tu || 40 ||
pariṣecanakāle tu rakṣādīpaṃ karoti hi | sarvapāpairvinirmuktaśśivalokamavāpnuyāt || 41 ||
rakṣādīpaṃ mayā proktaṃ aṅkurārpaṇakaṃ śṛṇu || 41.5 ||
[iti vīratantre rakṣādīpapaṭalaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 14 aṅkurārpaṇam] ||
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ pa(rya) (?) pṛcchat pitāmahaḥ | aṅkurārpaṇaṃ kiṃ vā tatsarvaṃ brūhi me prabho || 1 ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
nāgalāṅkurakarmaṃ tu yattvayā paricoditam | tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 2 ||
prathamaṃ dhvajāṅkuraṃ jñeyaṃ dvitīyaṃ cāṅkurādikam | utsavāṅkuramevoktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ || 3 ||
tīrthāṅkuraṃ caturthaṃ syāt caṇḍāṅkuraṃ tu pañcamam | athā trayaṅkuraṃ vidyāt dhvajāṅkuraṃ tu cocyate || 4 ||
tīrthāṅkuraṃ tu samāyuktaṃ aṅkurāṅkuramucyate | sthāpane prokṣaṇe yāge utsave snapane tathā || 5 ||
anye ca maṅgalākārye maṅgalāṅkuramucyate | śrīkaraṃ śrīnivāsaṃ ca śrīpadaṃ ca tridhā bhavet || 6 ||
pūrvāgraṃ tu catussūtramuttarāgraṃ tathaiva ca | kṛtvā navapadaṃ tatra devatāśca śṛṇuṣvatha || 7 ||
pade pūrve ca ṛgvedaṃ āgneyāṃ teja ucyate | dakṣiṇena yajurvedamākāśaṃ caiva nairṛte || 8 ||
paścime tu pade pūrve sāmamuttarataṃ tathā | vāyavye pavanaṃ caiva atharvaṃ somake pade || 9 ||
āpaścaiva tu īśānyāṃ madhye meraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | madhyame tu pade caiva somakumbhapratiṣṭhitam || 10 ||
ghaṭikā dikṣu vinyasya pālikā vā vidikṣu vai | etat śrīkaramityuktaṃ śrīnivāsamatha śṛṇu || 11 ||
pūrvāgraṃ pañcasūtraṃ syāduttarāgraṃ tathaiva ca | ṣoḍaśātpādamevāhurdevatānāṃ śṛṇuṣvatha || 12 ||
īśe jayanta ādityo agniśca vitato mayā | sugrīvo varuṇaśśeṣo mukhyassomoditastathā || 13 ||
brahmā catuṣpadaṃ caiva madhyame tu vyavasthitā | īśānaṃ caiva sugrīvo mukhyasya tu padāni ca || 14 ||
pālikādvinyasettatra ghaṭikāsthānamucyate | jayanto vijayaścaiva varuṇo soma eva ca || 15 ||
ghaṭikāsthānamevoktaṃ śarāvasthānakaṃ śṛṇu | ādityaśca yamaścaiva śoṣaśca vādini sthitā || 16 ||
madhyame somakumbhaṃ tu parito dvādaśā nyaset | etadvai śrīnivāsaṃ tu śrīpadaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha || 17 ||
ṣaṭrasūtraṃ caiva pūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ tathaiva ca | pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetkramaśastathā || 18 ||
īśo jayanta ādityo pūṣogninnirvitā yamaḥ | bhṛṅgaṃ ca mṛgasugrīvo varuṇaśśoṣamārutau || 19 ||
mukhya somo ditiścaiva bāhyadevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | āpa vatsārdha sāvitri vivasvāgnilamitrakaḥ || 20 ||
rudro bhūtataraścāntaṃ madhye brahmāṇamucyate | brahmāṇaṃ ca pade caiva sthāpayet somakumbhakam || 21 ||
īśānanto jayantaśca aśvinī vitatastathā | pitṛdauvārikaścaiva mārutaścaiva mukhyakaḥ || 22 ||
pālikā vinyasettatra śarāvaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha | āpavatsādi devāṣṭau ghaṭikā sthānamucyate || 23 ||
lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi kārayet || 24 ||
mātrāṅgulena kartavyaṃ pālikādīni caiva hi | pālikāmukhavistāraṃ viṃśatyaṅgulamuttamam || 25 ||
dvādaśāṅgulamadhye tadvalaya dvādaśāṅgulam | vistāreṇa samotsedhaṃ tadardhaṃ pādavistaram || 26 ||
parito'ṣṭau ca viprendra ṣaḍbhāgekamiti smṛtam | madhyame bilasaṃyuktaṃ darpaṇodaravatkṛtam || 27 ||
ghaṭistasyotsedhamānaṃ tu pālikāsamameva ca | ghaṭikodara vistāraṃ dvādaśāṅgulamucyate || 28 ||
vaktraṃ caiva ṣaḍaṅgulyaṃ pañcavaktrasamanvitam | pālikāpādavatkuryāt ghaṭilakṣaṇamucyate || 29 ||
aṣṭāṅgulaṃ tu vistāraṃ śārāvasya mukho bhavet | tadardhaṃ pādavistāraṃ tripādaṃ vā samucyate || 30 ||
bhedaṃ codaṃ ca kālaṃ ca suṣiraṃ caiva varjayet | ghaṭikā brahmadaivatyaṃ pālikā viṣṇurucyate || 31 ||
śārāvasyeśvaraḥ proktaḥ ityete adhidevatāḥ | caturviṃśatisaṃkhyāttu uttamaṃ tu vinirdiśet || 32 ||
pālikā ṣoḍaśaṃ caiva madhyamaṃ tu vinirdiśet | pālikā cāṣṭa vinyasya madhyamaṃ tadihocyate || 33 ||
utsavasyādirātrau tu bījānirvāhamucyate | navame saptame vāpi pañcame taṃ yajetsadā || 34 ||
bījānāmadhipassomastasmāttu niśivāpayet | grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt triśūlena samāyutam || 35 ||
pratimena samāyuktaṃ caṇḍeśena samāyutam | tadante pālikādīni dhārayet śivabhaktakān || 36 ||
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vātha dakṣiṇe vā viśeṣataḥ | suśuddhaṃ bhūtalaṃ prāpya prokṣayet śuddhavāriṇā || 37 ||
puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu arcayet hṛdayena tu | kundāliṃ caiva saṃpūjya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ || 38 ||
hṛdayena tu mantreṇa khādayeddeśiko bhuvi | mṛdaṃ saṃgrāhya vāmena hṛdīnā mṛdamarcayet || 39 ||
sarvatotyasamāyuktaṃ praviśedālayaṃ prati | prāsādasyograto vāpi īśāne dakṣiṇe tathā || 40 ||
uttareṇāpi viprendra gomayenānulepayet | aṣṭadroṇena śālissyāt sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettataḥ || 41 ||
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya prokṣayeddhṛdayena tu | madhyame somakumbhaṃ tu vinyasetsomabījakaiḥ || 42 ||
sakūrcaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca savastraṃ vāripūritam | gandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya naivedyaṃ dāpayettataḥ || 43 ||
tadbāhye pūrva vinyasya pālikādīni sarvaśaḥ | darbheṇa suṣiraṃ nyasya mṛdaṃ tatraiva pūrayet || 44 ||
toyena ca samāyuktaṃ pūjayeddhṛdayena tu | puṇyāhaṃ tatra kurvīta tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ || 45 ||
mudgamāṣakulutthaṃ ca tilanīvārameva ca | (**) vaśipi saṃyuktaṃ apāmārgaṃ ca sarṣapam || 46 ||
śyāmagodhūmasaṃyuktaṃ yavaveṇuṃ tathaiva ca | payasā kṣālayettatra hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ || 47 ||
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi ācāryo mantravigrahaḥ | pāpayet śivamantreṇa (*****) stu vāpayet || 48 ||
rudragaṇikā dāsī ca vāpayettu viśeṣataḥ | somādhidevatākumbhān abhiṣicya tato jalam || 49 ||
pālikādīni sarvāṇi satatāpa vivarjite | suṣuptadeśe saṃsthāpya somakumbhena saṃyutam || 50 ||
tat dinīdīni tīrthāntaṃ somarājasya deśikaḥ | havirnivedayettatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ || 51 ||
kṛṣṇadhūmranibhaścettu prāsādena śatāhutiḥ | homayeccaiva viprendra apūpāni tathaiva ca || 52 ||
evameva krameṇaiva aṅkurārpaṇamucyate | aṅkurārpaṇahīne tu rājarāṣṭrasya doṣakṛt || 53 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kuryāttanmaṅgalākaram | evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaśśivaloke mahīyate || 54 ||
aṅkurārpaṇamevoktaṃ utsavasya vidhiṃ śṛṇu || 54.5 ||
[iti vīratantre aṅkurārpaṇavidhiḥ paṭalaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 15 utsavasūcanam]
utsavaṃ yattvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tava snehādviśeṣataḥ | tatsarvamakhilaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 1 ||
sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpanivāraṇam | utgataṃ tutsavo yasmāt tasmādutsavamucyate || 2 ||
dīkṣāṃ caiva pratiṣṭhānte prokṣaṇānte tathaiva ca | jvara (*) māryāpravarttaṃ tu śatrupīḍaneṣu ca || 3 ||
dhanadhānyasamṛddhyaiva kṣāmakṣayakarāya ca | sarveṣāmiṣṭakāmārthaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || 4 ||
eṣu kāleṣu kuryāttu utsavaṃ vidhinādhunā | dvividhaṃ utsavaṃ caiva tayorbhedaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha || 5 ||
mārgaśīrṣaṃ ca māse tu ārdrāntaṃ syāt śivotsavaḥ | puṣyamāse tu puṣyāntaṃ māghamāse maghāntakam || 6 ||
phālgune cottarāṃ ca caitra citrāntamucyate | vaiśākhe tu viśākhāntaṃ mūlāntaṃ śreṣṭhamāsake || 7 ||
āṣāḍhaṃ cottarāṣāḍhaṃ śrāvaṇe śrāvaṇāntakam | pūrvāṣāḍhaṃ ca mevoktaṃ pūrvabhādreti māsake || 8 ||
āśvayuje va māse ca aśvinyāntaṃ tu kārayet | kṛttike kṛttikāntaṃ tu kārayettu śivotsavam || 9 ||
rājñā janmadinānte vā grāmanakṣatrameva vā | kartuśca janmanakṣatre kuryādutsavamucyate || 10 ||
sarvamāseṣu kartavyamārdrāntaṃ hi śivotsavam | śaivaṃ gauṇaṃ vibhūtaṃ ca bhauvanaṃ devikaṃ tathā || 11 ||
pañcabhedena kartavyaṃ śivotsavavidhikramam | eteṣāṃ bhedakaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 12 ||
śaiva bhedaṃ samākhyātaṃ ekāhaṃ utsavaṃ tataḥ | triyāhena samāyuktaṃ gauṇamityabhidhīyate || 13 ||
pañcāhaṃ bhautikaṃ proktaṃ saptāhaṃ bhauvanaṃ smṛtam | navāhena samāyuktaṃ daivikaṃ utsavaṃ smṛtam || 14 ||
sūryavāreṇa kuryāttu vārotsavamiti smṛtam | śanaiścarasya vāre tu tathā kāmadamucyate || 15 ||
vārotsave tu (***) mārtāṇḍīyamiti smṛtam | eteṣāṃ tu krameṇaiva vakṣyate vidhinā'dhunā || 16 ||
sāyaṃkāle samārabhya tatpūrve rātrisaṃyutam | homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau bali bhramaṇamācaret || 17 ||
balirekaṃ mayā proktaṃ ekāhe utsave tathā | aparedyuścaiva viprendra tīrthaṃ kuryāttu deśikaḥ || 18 ||
evameva krameṇaiva dvividhaṃ cocyate mayā | triyaheṣu ca viprendra sāyaṃkāle samārabhet || 19 ||
prātaḥkāle tu tīrthaṃ syāt (**********) | idamanyatprakāreṇa triyahaṃ vakṣyate'dhunā || 20 ||
sāyaṃkāle tadārabhya tadrātrau adhivāsayet | homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau tadrātrau balimārabhet || 21 ||
dine dine dine caiva balirekaṃ vidhīyate | balyante caiva viprendra cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet || 22 ||
cūrṇotsavānte tīrthaṃ syāt dvividhaṃ cocyate mayā | pañcāhaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 23 ||
aṣṭāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhet | homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva dadet punaḥ || 24 ||
caturdaśabaliṃ dadyāt sūrṇotkārayet | tīrthaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa idamanya śṛṇu || 25 ||
sāyaṃkālaṃ samārabhya tatpūrve dinamārabhet | ṣaṣṭhāhe tu ca pūrvāhṇe cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet || 26 ||
tīrthaṃ caiva prakartavyaṃ idamanyat śṛṇuṣva hi | sāyaṃkāle samārabhya pañcāhaṃ syāt dine tathā || 27 ||
homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau balirekā vidhīyate | dvitīye ca tṛtīye ca caturthaṃ tu balidvayam || 28 ||
pañcame balirekaṃ syāt cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet | kuryādvai tīrthakarmaṃ tu dvividhaṃ cocyate mayā || 29 ||
saptāhaṃ caiva vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | aṣṭāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhet || 30 ||
homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva dadetpunaḥ | caturdaśabaliṃ dadyāt cūrṇotsavaṃ tu kārayet || 31 ||
tīrthaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa idamanyat śṛṇuṣvatha | saptāhe sāyamārabhya adhivāsya tato budhaḥ || 32 ||
homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau balirekaṃ dadetpunaḥ | dvitīye divase caiva tṛtīye'pi caturthake || 33 ||
pañcame ṣaṣṭhame caiva balidvayasamācaret | saptāhaṃ balirekā syāt balyante cūrṇamucyate || 34 ||
tatra tīrthaṃ samārabhya yāvatkālaukamuttamam | saptāhaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ navāhaṃ ca śṛṇuṣvatha || 35 ||
tatpūrvarātrimārabhya tadrātrau cādhivāsayet | homaṃ kuryāttu tadrātrau baliṃ caiva tu dāpayet || 36 ||
tat dinādīttu tīrthāntaṃ tatkāle va baliṃ dadet | cūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tīrthaṃ kuryāttate budhaḥ || 37 ||
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | navāhe caiva sāyāhne adhivāsanamārabhet || 38 ||
aṅkuraṃ kuryāt tadrātrau baliṃ caiva tu dāpayet | dvitīya divase caiva tṛtīye'pi caturthakam || 39 ||
pañcame caiva ṣaṣṭhāhe saptāhe dvitayaṃ balim | navāhe'pi ca viprendra daśāhe tu baliṃ kṣipet || 40 ||
cūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tīrthakarma samārabhet | navāhe dvividhaṃ kuryāt procyate kamalāsana || 41 ||
evameva krameṇaiva kuryāt pañcavidhānataḥ | vārapūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 42 ||
prātaḥkālaṃ samārabhya dviguṇaṃ pūjayecchivam | puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra havirnivedayettataḥ || 43 ||
indrādyeśānaparyantaṃ lokapālabaliṃ dadet | nityotsavasya kāle tu kuryāt grāmapradakṣiṇam || 44 ||
rathaṃ vā śibikāṃ vātha śirasā vāhayettataḥ | praviśedālayaṃ tatra pādukārcanamucyate || 45 ||
sūryavāramidaṃ proktaṃ śanivāramathāpi vā | liṅge vā pratimāyāṃ vā tailābhyaṅgamihocyate || 46 ||
abhiṣekaṃ tu kartavyaṃ hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ | havirnivedayetpaścāt lokapālabaliṃ kṣipet || 47 ||
śaivān saṃbhojaye paricārakramaṃ kuru | grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvatodya samanvitam || 48 ||
mārtāṇḍīyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | sāyaṃkālaṃ samārabhya prātaḥkāle baliṃ dadet || 49 ||
tīrthānte pūrvarātrau tu lokapālabaliṃ kṣipet | maṇṭapāt dakṣiṇe pārśve sthāpayet kalaśaṃ nava || 50 ||
tato homaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam | samidājyacarūṃścaiva suhutvā pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 51 ||
annaliṅgasamāyuktaṃ astrarājena saṃyutam | baliṃ dadyāttu viprendra sāyaṃkāle viśeṣataḥ || 52 ||
tataḥ prabhāte pratimāṃ kuryāt grāmapradakṣiṇam | tīrthaṃ kuryāttato vidvān praviśedālayaṃ prati || 53 ||
evameva krameṇaiva budhavāre viśeṣataḥ | mārttāṇḍīyamidaṃ proktaṃ (*) māraṃ ca śṛṇu dvija || 54 ||
aṅkurārpaṇapūrvaṃ ca dhvajārohaṇasamanvitam | samidājyacarūṃśvaiva (*****) pūrvakam || 55 ||
bherītāḍanapūrvaṃ tu trividhaṃ cocyate mayā | aṅkurānarpayedvidvān dhvajamāropayettataḥ || 56 ||
bherīṃ tu tāḍayitvā tu aṅkurārpaṇa pūrvakam | dhvajamāropayet paścāt bherīṃ caiva tu tāḍayet || 57 ||
aṅkurānarpayedvidvān dhvajārohaṇa pūrvakam | bherīṃ tu tāḍayitvā tu dhvajamāropayettataḥ || 58 ||
aṅkurānarpayedvidvān bherītāḍana pūrvakam | evameva krameṇaiva trividhaṃ cocyate mayā || 59 ||
nandinaṃ caiva viprendra triguṇīkṛtya ropayet | dviguṇīkṛtya vā kuryāddhvajamāropayettataḥ || 60 ||
utsavasyādirātrau tu dhvajāropaṇamucyate | bhauvane daivike kuryādanyeṣu ca vivarjayet || 61 ||
samudrasnāna utpanne parvayuktirvidhīyate | yaddineṣu prabhā kuryāt tatpūrve vā pare'pi vā || 62 ||
itareṣāṃ pare vipra tattaddineṣu kārayet | nadīnada taṭākeṣu nakṣatre tīrthamucyate || 63 ||
yatpakṣe yaddine vāre hastarvādi divākaraḥ | taddine saṃkramo bhāge divā tīrthaṃ ca niścayaḥ || 64 ||
śivasyāvabhṛthaṃ kuryāt snapanaṃ tadanantare | evameva krameṇaiva utsavaṃ kārayettataḥ || 65 ||
utsavārambhamevoktaṃ vṛṣayāgamatha śṛṇu |
[iti utsavasūcanaṃ samāptaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 16 vṛṣayāgaḥ]
vṛṣayāgaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana | prāsādasyāgrataḥ kuryāt maṇṭapaṃ caturaśrakam || 1 ||
maṇṭapasya tu tanmadhye kuryādvṛṣabhayāgakam | darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālāvalambitam || 2 ||
indrādīśānaparyantaṃ aṣṭadikṣu dhvajāṣṭakam | lokapālādhidaivatyaṃ svasvarūpaṃ tu lāñcayet || 3 ||
vinyasettu dhvajaṃ sūtraṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitam | vitānenordhvamācchādya muktādāmairalaṃkṛtam || 4 ||
vṛṣadevaṃ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādinā tataḥ | mudgānnaṃ caiva dātavyaṃ upadaṃśa samanvitam || 5 ||
tadagre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā śālibhirvimalaistataḥ | aṣṭadroṇena śāliṃ tu tadardhaṃ taṇḍulairapi || 6 ||
tadardhaṃ tu tilā nyasya padmaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ | tasyopari nyasettatra kalaśānnavasaṃkhyayā || 7 ||
madhyasthapadamekaikaṃ sasūtrān sāpidhānakān | pūrayet gandhatoyena svarṇaṃ tatra vinikṣipet || 8 ||
vṛṣabījaṃ samuddhṛtya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet | pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyasedaṣṭakumbhakān || 9 ||
pādyaṃ pūrvaṃ nyasedyatra āgneyyāṃ puṣpamucyate | ācamanaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya phalodakaṃ tu nairṛte || 10 ||
arghyaṃ paścimato nyasya balidānaṃ tu vāyavye | uttare pañcagavyaṃ tu īśe ratnodakaṃ nyaset || 11 ||
gandhādinārcayettatra devatā vinyasettataḥ | vṛṣabhaṃ madhyame nyasya ukṣāṇaṃ pūrvato nyaset || 12 ||
gopatiṃ cāgnidigbhāge śṛṅgiṇaṃ caiva dakṣiṇe | nairṛtyāṃ caiva nandī syāt paścime tu vaśet patim || 13 ||
vṛṣāṇi vāyudigbhāge śaṅkukarṇastathottare | mahodaraṃ tu īśānyāṃ vinyaset kalaśeṣu ca || 14 ||
kalaśān pūrvadigbhāge śālinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kuru | aṣṭapatraṃ samālikhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret || 15 ||
dhvajapaṭaṃ vinyasettatra (*) ṇena samanvitam | uttamaṃ daśahastaṃ tu madhyamaṃ navahastakam || 16 ||
adhamaṃ cāṣṭahastaṃ syāt madhyamaṃ navahastakam | ardhādhike tritālaṃ tu paṭadairghya mihocyate || 17 ||
ṣaṭtālamuttamaṃ proktaṃ pañcatālaṃ tu madhyamam | ardhādhike tritālaṃ tu kanyastaṃ tviha cocyate || 18 ||
paṭavistāramānaṃ tu caturbhāgaikameva tu | brāhmaṇasya bhavet śvetaṃ kṣatriyasya tu raktakam || 19 ||
pītaṃ vaiśyasya ityuktaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tu śūdrakam | vistāreṇa samaṃ pucchaṃ pucchārdhaṃ śikharaṃ bhavet || 20 ||
madhyamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ pucchāt sthitaṃ vā śayanaṃ tu vā | vṛṣabhaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu raktavarṇaṃ tu śṛṅgakam || 21 ||
khurāṇāṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu pītaṃ lāṅgūlameva ca | netre śvetamayī caiva madhyaraktamayī yathā || 22 ||
vṛṣabhaṃ madhyapīṭhaṃ tu maṇimālāvibhūṣitam | paśudīpadvayo nyasya citramūrdhve tu vinyaset || 23 ||
dvau pārśvau cāmarābhyāṃ tu lekhayet vṛṣabhaṃ tataḥ | pūrvedyuradhivāsaṃ ca dhvajadaṇḍena saṃyutam || 24 ||
prokṣayedambhasā caiva hṛdayena tu mantrataḥ | gandhapuṣpādinā pūjya vṛṣagāyatrimantrataḥ || 25 ||
pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ vṛṣamūrtiṃ nyasettataḥ | tadante lokapālāṃśca pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ || 26 ||
tadbāhye pūjayettatra lokapālāstrameva ca | tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge śālikā sthaṇḍilaṃ kuru || 27 ||
padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret | tadūrdhve vinyasenmūlaṃ pūjayettu viśeṣataḥ || 28 ||
vāmādīnāṃ tu śaktīnāṃ śūlamūle pratiṣṭhitam | kumāraṃ pālike nyasya kumbhe tu varuṇaṃ nyaset || 29 ||
tāsi caivāgnidaivatyaṃ sarasvatī caiva daṇḍakam | pīṭhe tu pārvatīṃ nyasya bhūmibhāge vasundarīm || 30 ||
gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca ṣaṇṇavatyena pūjayet | puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ || 31 ||
tato homaṃ prakurvīta sthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśrakam | śivāgnimānayettatra agnimukhaṃ ca hūyate || 32 ||
samidājyacarūn lājān sarṣapāṃścaiva hūyate | pañcabrahmeṇa saṃyuktaṃ īśānādīni hūyate || 33 ||
pratyekaṃ śatamardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vāpi hūyate | vṛṣāśivāsanaṃ proktaṃ dhvajārohaṇakaṃ śṛṇu || 34 ||
[iti vṛṣayāgassamāptaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 17 dhvajārohaṇavidhiḥ]
dhvajārohaṇamevaṃ tu vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sattamaḥ | śvetavarṇaṃ dhvajaṃ caiva rājarāṣṭra vivardhanam || 1 ||
vaśyaṃ vai raktavarṇaṃ tu stambhanaṃ pītamucyate | vijayaṃ kapilābhaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ caivābhicārakam || 2 ||
dhūmraṃ vyādhipradaṃ caiva evameva krameṇa tu | (?) dhānyān kāmānyakāmāya toṃ tāntānvai sādhayet dhvajaḥ || 3 ||
varṣārthaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ tu kṣīrābhaṃ sarvaśāntikam | śaṅkhasphaṭikamuktābhaṃ rakṣārthaṃ śāntipuṣṭikam || 4 ||
pūrvāhṇe brahmaṇaḥ prītirmadhyāhne rājyavṛddhidam | rātrau vaiśyasya śūdrāṇāṃ vardhate kramaśastathā || 5 ||
dhvajasthānamahaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ kamalāsana | pīṭhagopurayormadhye vṛṣasya ca purato'pi vā || 6 ||
pīṭhāgre vātha kuryāttu dhvajasthānaṃ vidhīyate | kramukaṃ veṇudaṇḍaṃ ca candanaṃ vāpi khādiram || 7 ||
campakaṃ devadāruṃ ca stambakairbilvakairapi | avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ caiva kṛmikoṭaravarjitam || 8 ||
prāsādasya samaṃ vāpi prāsādagrīvameva ca | vṛṣabhasthala samaṃ vāpi gopurotsedhameva ca || 9 ||
tulāntaṃ ca tulāntaṃ vā daṇḍasyotsedhamucyate | hastasaṃkhyena vā kuryāt triṃśaddhastamathāpi vā || 10 ||
dvādaśaṃ daśahastaṃ vā dhvajasyotsedhamucyate | saptatriṃśāṅgulaṃ vāpi caturviṃśatireva vā || 11 ||
dvāviṃśatibhirvātha nāhaṃ tasya vidhīyate | veṇuyaṣṭiṃ tato grāhya avakraṃ nirvraṇaṃ tataḥ || 12 ||
ekaparvaṃ vināśārthaṃ dviparveṇa bhayaṃkaram | triparvaṃ vyādhinaṃ pīḍyaṃ catuṣparva vināśinaḥ || 13 ||
pañcaparvāt bhayaṃ loke ṣaṭparvaṃ syā śriyaṃ bhavet | saptaparvān gavāṃ nāśaḥ aṣṭaparvaistu vardhate || 14 ||
navaparvān kulaṃ kṣīṇaṃ daśamaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ | ekādaśaṃ putrakāmaḥ dvādaśaṃ puṣṭikāmadam || 15 ||
idaṃ ūrdhvaṃ na kartavyaṃ hastamānaṃ tataśśṛṇu | ṣaṭtālaṃ pañcatālaṃ vā tasyāgre ghaṭikāṃ nyaset || 16 ||
ādhāraphala trīṇi ca yājñikairvṛkṣasaṃbhavaiḥ | hastamātrāntaraṃ jñeyaṃ hastaṃ vā suṣiradvayam || 17 ||
evameva pramāṇena tantunā rajjurucyate | agraghaṭikāmūlāntaṃ rajjudviguṇaṃ kārayet || 18 ||
māṇavakaśśucirbhūtvā prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ | navavastraparīdhānā soṣṇīyaṃ cottarīyakam || 19 ||
anyadhvajāṃśca kuryāttu evameva pradakṣiṇam | tasyānte cāstrarājānamannaliṅgasamāyutam || 20 ||
nānādhvajasamāyuktaṃ nānāpiñchasamāyutam | nānājanasamākīrṇaṃ nānāvādyasamāyutam || 21 ||
nānācitrasamāyuktaṃ brahmaghoṣasamanvitam | maṅgalāṅkurasamāyuktaṃ nṛttageyasamanvitam || 22 ||
agrataḥ pṛṣṭhato gatvā ācāryo yajamānakaḥ | śanaiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā dhvajasthānaṃ praverayet || 23 ||
aṃ cātamāghatāttatra hastadvayapramāṇataḥ | tasya mūle prakartavyaṃ vedilakṣaṇasaṃyutam || 24 ||
ṣaṭtālamadhye vinyasya svarṇakūrmaṃ tu meva ca | puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra prokṣayet śuddhavāriṇā || 25 ||
hṛdayena tu mantreṇa kṣālayet dhvajadaṇḍakam | darbhamālābhirāveṣṭya puṣpamālāsamanvitam || 26 ||
vṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa prokṣayetkalaśodakaiḥ | utthāya dhvajadaṇḍaṃ tu vyomavyāpi samuccaran || 27 ||
vālukena hṛdā caiva pūrayedāghatāṃ tataḥ | tasya mūle prakartavyaṃ vedikālakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || 28 ||
ṣaṭtālaṃ pañcatālaṃ vā catustālamathāpi vā | vistaraḥ procyate vipra utsedhaṃ tu tadardhakam || 29 ||
tadūrdhve padma saṃkalpya aṣṭapatra suśobhanam | evamekhalamevaṃ syāt mekhalātrayameva ca || 30 ||
utsedhaṃ tu tridhā bhajya ekaikamekhalocchrayam | adhastamekhalā caiva bhūmidevīṃ tu vinyaset || 31 ||
śrīdevīṃ madhyame pūjya tṛtīye ca sarasvatī | trimekhaleṣu viprendra śaktīnāṃ traya kalpayet || 32 ||
ekamekhalayā kuryāt bhūmidevīṃ nyasettataḥ | pūjayedgandhapuṣpeṇa dhūpadīpaissamanvitam || 33 ||
sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettatra caturdroṇena śālinā | puṇyāhaṃ kārayettatra kalaśān vinyasennavam || 34 ||
madhyame vṛṣabhakumbhaṃ tu vṛṣamantreṇa vinyaset | indrādīśānaparyantaṃ vinyaset kalaśaṃ tataḥ || 35 ||
savastrān sāpidhānāṃśca lokapālādhidevatāḥ | snāpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ vṛṣayantrī ca mantrataḥ || 36 ||
nivedayettu mudgānnaṃ dadhyopadaṃśasaṃyutam | (?) etatkāle tu pūjātīnāṃ piṇḍānyān bhojayettataḥ || 37 ||
kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇena piṇḍaṃ kuryāttu deśikaḥ | vṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa piṇḍaṃ dadyāttu deśikaḥ || 38 ||
vṛṣabhaṃ bhartṛvat samṛtvā triḥ kṛtvā tu pradakṣiṇam | namaskāraṃ tu kartavyaṃ dhvajamūle samāśritaḥ || 39 ||
evaṃ kuryāttu viprendra cāturvarṇaṃ tu dāpayet | anyajātistu sarveṣāṃ pratilomāśca kārayet || 40 ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastrahemāṅgulīyakaiḥ | tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettasmai janānsarvānviśeṣataḥ || 41 ||
[iti vīratantre dhvajārohaṇavidhiḥ samāptaḥ] ||
[paṭalaḥ 18 bherītāḍanam] (?)
idaṃ ūrdhvaṃ prakartavyaṃ bherītāḍanamuttamam | prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne dhvajamāropayettataḥ || 1 ||
tadrātrau tāḍayedbherīṃ lakṣaṇena samanvitam | lakṣaṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalāsana || 2 ||
āsanaṃ candanairvāpi vakulaiśca śirīṣakaiḥ | vyadhavṛkṣeṇa vā kuryāt bherīṃ vā paṭahaṃ tu vā || 3 ||
āyāmaṃ tu trihastaṃ syāt uttamaṃ tu vidhīyate | pañcatālaṃ tu madhyaṃ syāt ṣaḍaṅgulavihīnakam || 4 ||
āyāmaṃ ce taduddiṣṭaṃ trividhaṃ cocyate mayā | āyāmasya samaṃ nāhaṃ madhye paṭahamucyate || 5 ||
vaktraṃ vai dvādaśāṅgulyaṃ navabhissaptabhiśca vā | evameva krameṇaiva kṛtvā paṭahamuttamam || 6 ||
gocarmeṇa tu bandhaṃ syāt mahādhvanisamāyutam | maddalaiḥ kāhalaiścaiva kāṃsyadhvanisamāyutam || 7 ||
jhallarī jharjharī montaiḥ khaṇḍikā ca samanvitam | anyaiśca sarvavādyaiśca yathālābhena tāḍayet || 8 ||
prāsādasyāgrataścaiva maṇṭapaṃ kārayettataḥ | maṇṭapasya tu madhye tu gomayenānulepayet || 9 ||
sthaṇḍiladvitayaṃ kṛtvā śālinā ca tathaiva ca | aṣṭadroṇena śālī syāt sthaṇḍilau dvau tu kārayet || 10 ||
tadardhaṃ taṇḍulairyuktaṃ prokṣayedambhasā tataḥ | padmapatraṃ samālikhya darbhaiścaiva paristaret || 11 ||
paṭahasya dalaṃkāraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettataḥ || paṭahaṃ vinyasettatra navavastrasamanvitam || 12 ||
tadagre sthāpayecchūlaṃ astramantreṇa deśikaḥ | gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiścaruṃ nivedayet || 13 ||
evaṃ vai pūjayecchūlaṃ paścādbherīṃ samarcayet | uttarābhimukho bhūtvā arcayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ || 14 ||
āpohiṣṭhetimantreṇa prokṣayitvā kuśāmbhasā | paṭahaṃ vinyasettatra hṛdayena tu pūjayet || 15 ||
dakṣiṇe rudramabhyarcya vāme viṣṇuṃ tathaiva ca | brahmāṇaṃ pūjayenmadhye evameva krameṇa tu || 16 ||
vāsukīcarmasūtre tu valayau ravicandramau | mātarassanti kīle tu udare tu vyavasthitaḥ || 17 ||
kodaṇḍena samāyuktaṃ pūjayet satramantrataḥ | vādyakaṃ ca samāhūya sthānakarma samācaret || 18 ||
śuklavastra parīdhānaṃ gandhamālānulepanam | nandikeśvaramāvāhya nandimantrasamanvitam || 19 ||
arcayitvā yathānyāyaṃ gandhapuṣpādinā tataḥ | paṭahasyaiva viprendra havirnivedayettataḥ || 20 ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vādyaṃ saṃpūjayettataḥ | vāmadevena mantreṇa arcayitvā viśeṣataḥ || 21 ||
tāḍayecchivamantreṇa ācāryo mantravigrahaḥ | vādyakastāḍayetpaścāt nandimantreṇa saṃyutam || 22 ||
kulodgato viditātmā tāḍayettālameva ca | carcapuṭaṃ tu brahmāṇaṃ cācapuṭa dvitīyake || 23 ||
